limit \emph{at} the line $s=1/2$ --- no mass loss; the single place
the zero fluctuation enters; (L2) node convergence as a theorem
(capture is classical; the super-resolution is resolved as
classical atom pinning in the keystone round,
\vref{sec:wall-four-languages}); (L3) routine lemmas, exhibited
with constants.  \texttt{PRIME.Z1.OPERATOR.01}
and \texttt{PRIME.Z1.MOONSHOT.01} stay \emph{open}; positivity ---
the Weil criterion --- is untouched; \textbf{no RH claim}.

\subsection{The keystone round: the wall in four equivalent
languages}\label{sec:wall-four-languages}

The closing round of the same day takes the end ledger of the
moonshot arc and does the one thing left to do with a wall: walk its
entire length and name it precisely, in every language it speaks.
Eight further modules land (\veri{v727\_l1\_identification.py}
through \veri{v734\_s1\_canonical.py}); the fence stays exactly
where it was --- \textbf{no RH claim, no marker moves} --- but the
remaining substance is now \emph{maximally localized}.

\emph{The wall, maximally precise}
(\veri{v727\_l1\_identification.py}, $11/11$,
\texttt{L1-DETERMINED-WALL-TYPED}).  The identification slice first
clears the classical ground: the raw $\tau$-measure does \emph{not}
carry the limit (its naive moments grow one power under the density
law; measured slopes $2.254/4.245$) --- the Weil object is the
per-bandwidth lag reading, and in the Gauss-damped frame on the
Weil axis the ladder moments are Cauchy and \emph{identify} against
the closed geometric side to $1.4\times10^{-3}$ over
$m_0..m_{16}$; the measured Gauss/Freud growth band $[0.638,1.117]$
makes the Carleman sum diverge: the limit moment problem is
\emph{determined}, classically, with RH nowhere in the argument.
The identification chain then reads: (a) the vague limit exists
[measured tightness]; (b) the moment problem is determined
[classical]; (c) the limit moments equal the geometric side
[machine-exact per window, $4.7\times10^{-14}$]; (d) the geometric
side equals the zero side [Weil 1952 --- classical and
\emph{unconditional}, wherever the zeros lie].  The seeming paradox
--- ``$T_h$ is PD'' plus ``$T_h\to W$'' would naively give the Weil
criterion, i.e.\ RH --- resolves honestly: \emph{``$T_h$ is PD'' is
a measurement per $h$, not a theorem} (the scramble control breaks
Levinson at depth $61$).  What remains is one statement, the wall:
\textbf{PD persistence} --- infinitely many windows of the ladder
are positive definite.  That \emph{suffices} for RH (PD on a
subsequence, plus the (c) rates, plus (d), gives $W(g*\tilde g)\ge
0$ for all compactly supported $g$); each window is a \emph{finite}
Levinson computation, measured $9/9$ (min headroom $0.718$); the
converse (RH $\Rightarrow$ every finite window PD) is \emph{not}
shown --- an honest asymmetry.  By Riesz--Haviland plus determinacy
the same statement reads: \emph{the geometric side defines a
positive measure on $\mathbb{R}$}.

\emph{The four languages.}  On the largest window all readings are
computed side by side, and with the canonical-system slice
(\veri{v734\_s1\_canonical.py}, $10/10$,
\texttt{S1-CANONICAL-SUZUKI-BRIDGED}) the count reaches four
equivalent languages for the \emph{same} wall, each finitely
decidable per window, all measured $9/9$:
\begin{itemize}
\item \emph{Moments} (Hankel-PD): the damped moment matrices are
PSD --- min eigenvalue $1.37\times10^{-11}\ge0$ at $h=1433$;
\item \emph{State} (Levinson-PD): the lag vectors pass Levinson
with headroom $0.830$ --- $T_h$ is a GNS vector state;
\item \emph{Symbol} (Fej\'er $\ge0$): the window symbol is
nonnegative --- minimum $6.48\times10^{-3}$;
\item \emph{Hamiltonian} (Krein $l_k>0$): the Jacobi/Wheeler data
define, via an exact Krein correspondence (Weyl identity to
$1.6\times10^{-15}$ over $4$ complex $z\times9$ windows), a
canonical-system Hamiltonian $H_h$ with rank-one steps; $H_h\ge0$
iff all $l_k>0$ --- measured: min $l_k=0.033..0.377$, all positive;
the boundary phase carries the $\gamma$-side with scale
\emph{exactly} $1$, and the scramble breaks the Wheeler/Krein chain
at depth $31$.
\end{itemize}
The $h$-universal quantifier --- \emph{all} (or infinitely many)
windows --- is the RH substance; everything below it is a finite
computation.

\emph{The literature anchor, stated as the dual council reads it.}
The wall is not new; it has three names.  \emph{Weil 1952}: RH is
equivalent to the positivity of the explicit-formula functional
$W(g*\tilde g)\ge0$ --- our language (d) is his identity,
unconditional.  \emph{Connes 1999} (Selecta Math.\ 5, the global
trace formula) and \emph{Connes--Consani 2021} (the Sonin-space
zeta-cycles): the positivity route through the ad\`ele class space,
where the unconditional part lives on the atom-free regime $|u| <
\log 2$ --- exactly the regime our functional-equation symmetry
buys, and no more (\veri{v729\_strat2\_rp\_universality.py} below).
\emph{Suzuki 2021} (JFA 281, 109116): GRH is equivalent to the
positivity/existence of an explicitly constructed canonical-system
family, built unconditionally only for $\omega>1$ --- exactly the
classical half-plane $s>1/2$ where our K2 collapse already lives;
our $H_h$ is the first \emph{computable, zeta-free} truncation
family with the same Weyl/phase data and a measurable $H\ge0$
witness per window.  And the proven boundary line is \emph{Meyer
2005}: an unconditional spectral realization of the zeros
\emph{exists} --- but on a space without positivity; the spectral
realization alone is not the theorem, positivity is.  What TFPT
adds to this map is not a fourth name for the wall but a
\emph{computable, zeta-free truncation framework with emergent
prime places}, in which all four languages become finite
per-window decisions with measured convergence rates --- the wall
becomes an object one can walk up to and measure, which is exactly
what these modules do, and nothing more.

\emph{The K1 diagram, closed classically.}  The super-resolution
riddle of the moonshot arc (certified capture radii ${\sim}900\times$
above the measured node errors) is resolved --- classically.  The
memo's locality/symmetry mechanism is \emph{dead}
(\veri{v728\_k1b\_superresolution.py}, $11/13$ with the two
\emph{preregistered} memo bars dying honestly,
\texttt{K1B-ATOM-PINNING}): what carries the scale is
\emph{atom pinning} of the raw measure --- Nevai-type mass-point
attraction, lab rate $K^{-1.84}$, node-weight ratio $\to1.03$,
real-data correlate $0.64$.  Behind it sits an explicit
\emph{pinning lemma} (\veri{v730\_strat2\_pinning\_lemma.py},
$12/12$): a residual bound and its Kato--Temple sharpening,
one-line proofs each, $0$ violations at $598$ symbol peaks and
$535$ matched band zeros including \emph{all} $377$ of the largest
window --- and the certificate \emph{saturates at the window
width}: sub-width certification requires raw atomicity beyond
every finite window depth.  The gap layer between the atoms
supports \emph{emerging} bulk universality at kernel-shape level
(\veri{v729\_strat2\_rp\_universality.py}, $5/5$) but the strong
measured form is \emph{killed} on the preregistered bar
(\veri{v731\_strat2\_gap\_universality.py}, $5/5$,
\texttt{GAP-UNIV-KILLED}: the deviation plateaus at $0.33$ and the
uniform-in-$h$ Szeg\H{o} condition breaks like $h^{-0.64}$); what
remains there is a \emph{conditional} fixed-window theorem
candidate on the exact literature route (Lubinsky 2009;
Levin--Lubinsky 2008; Avila--Last--Simon 2010; Totik 2009).  The
diagram closes:
\[
\underbrace{\text{capture theorem}}_{\text{v721, certified}}
+\underbrace{\text{pinning lemma}}_{\text{v730, certified}}
+\underbrace{\text{conditional gap rigidity}}_{\text{v731, conditional}}
+\underbrace{\text{atom structure}}_{= \text{L1, open}}
\;=\;\text{K1}.
\]
Everything above the wall is classical; the single non-classical
input left anywhere in the diagram is L1 --- raw atomicity beyond
window depth, which is the PD-persistence wall again.

\emph{Two more honest kills, and a weak functor.}  The naive
Osterwalder--Schrader reflection-positivity route is dead on the
truncations (\veri{v729\_strat2\_rp\_universality.py}: the total
window fails plain \emph{and} KMS-twisted RP at full scale; the
deployed positivity lives only on the Toeplitz/Bochner axis).  The
\emph{direct} transfer of the Connes--Consani Sonin compression to
the window discretization is dead
(\veri{v732\_strat3\_sonin\_prolate.py}, all $21$ construction
checks pass and the preregistered kill fires: bad rank grows
$19\to86$) --- fenced cleanly: this kills the chosen one-cell
cutoff on \emph{these} truncations, not the CC mechanism itself,
and retuning the cutoff after the result is forbidden.  In the
other direction a first exact bridge \emph{into} Connes' framework
does exist: on the finite periodic-orbit Laurent basis for
$S=\{\infty,2,3,5\}$, the $\sigma$-descended TFPT groupoid maps by
an exact coefficient-one graded $*$-algebra functor candidate into
the $S$-local periodic-orbit subalgebra
(\veri{v733\_strat3\_gate0\_census.py}, $13/13$,
\texttt{GATE0-WEAK-FUNCTOR}: $6859$ convolutions with deviation
$0$, $\kappa\equiv1$ at all three places) --- with the extension to
the full ad\`ele-class algebra typed as \emph{open}.  A closing
slice completes the route portfolio honestly: the state-transport
route also stagnates
(\veri{v735\_strat3\_ucp\_inductive.py}, $10/10$ construction
checks, \texttt{UCP-STAGNATES}: all eight adjacent GNS-ladder maps
exist \emph{exactly} as UCP quantile couplings with linearly
controlled Choi rank, slope $0.991$, but the preregistered
shift/grade covariance gate fails --- mere state transport is not
the missing L1 mechanism), so the L1 portfolio now reads: Sonin
dead, UCP stagnates, Gate~0 weak functor, Suzuki bridge a
measurement --- what remains for L1 is atomicity/identification
substance, not transport machinery.

\emph{The final fence.}  Nothing in this round moves a marker.
The wall now has a maximally precise statement (PD persistence),
four equivalent finite languages, a classical closure of
everything around it, and honest graves for the routes that died.
The $h$-quantifier remains unproven; \textbf{no statement about
the Riemann Hypothesis is made}.

\subsection{The morning after: four review strikes}
\label{sec:review-strikes}

The external review of the keystone round proposed four
simplifications and sharpenings; all four were machine-tested the
next morning, and the results split cleanly into two exact
structures and two honest kills.

\emph{Strike 1 --- the orbit packet lemma (exact).}  On the E8 side
the review's compact number family closes as a lemma
(\veri{v736\_orbit\_packet.py}, $26/26$,
\texttt{ORBIT-PACKET-EXACT}): the $\sigma$ orbit census on the $15$
nonzero Gaussian classes gives Burnside $7=(15+3+3)/3$; the $240$
roots split canonically as $240=5\times48$ (one fixed block $+$ four
moved blocks of $12$ Gaussian lines each, label-free canonical);
the fixed-syndrome leader weights $(0,1,1,2)$ reproduce the
$(1,1,2)$ anchor with leader pair $e_6/e_7$; and the $q=16$ normal
form reads $240=16\cdot15$, $248=240+8$.  The circularity fence is
part of the lemma: P1 and P2 come back as \emph{exact internal
reconstruction}, not derivation, and the packet law is
$\sigma$-class-specific (free order-$3$ elements give Burnside $5$).

\emph{Strike 2 --- the seam-48 intertwiner (dead).}  The sharpest
structural sharpening --- a canonical intertwiner between the five
$48$-blocks and the $48$ regular five-cycles --- dies on its
preregistered criterion (\veri{v737\_seam48\_intertwiner.py},
$24/24$ machinery, \texttt{SEAM48-DEAD}): the $48\times5$ incidence
matrix is not identically $1$ (entry distribution
$0{:}96/1{:}64/2{:}64/3{:}16$), representative-independent over all
$2304$ order-$5$ elements, with the must-fail control firing.  The
residues are themselves structure: the four moved blocks carry the
v623 character table \emph{exactly}, the fixed block deviates
exactly by the $12$ lifted marks, and $u^5=\pm J$ holds exactly ---
but $240=48\cdot5$ remains a factorization \emph{without}
coordinatization.

\emph{Strike 3 --- the ramified fiber and the seven channels
(exact).}  The review's ``local fiber at the ramified place''
thesis holds at the level it was stated
(\veri{v738\_hecke\_mod\_ramified.py}, $34/34$,
\texttt{HECKE-MOD-RAMIFIED-CHANNELS}): the Gaussian--E8 Hecke tower
projects onto $V=L/(1+i)L$ exactly and $\sigma$-functorially over
all $5907$ submodules; every odd layer acts as
$\mathrm{degree}\cdot\mathrm{id}$ (the fiber is Hecke-rigid), while
the ramified layer \emph{is} the $15$ hyperplanes of $V$ with the
$2{:}1$ deck.  The channel structure resolves the review's
$7$-vs-$8$: the $\sigma$-orbits give $3$ fixed $+$ $4$ moved $=7$
nontrivial channels $+1$ trivial; NS/R is the $\sigma$-fixed parity
character (the v722 grading re-derived), and ram-odd
($n=2,8,32,\ldots$) is the unique negative-pressure channel.  The
honest boundary stands: the W3 margin is \emph{cross-channel
cancellation} --- the projection alone yields no transfer-matrix
reduction.

\emph{Strike 4 --- the rank-3 jet simplification (dead).}  The
review's reading of the rank-3 wall as a first-jet identity is
killed by its own $\varepsilon^0$ test
(\veri{v739\_rank3\_jet.py}, $20/20$, \texttt{RANK3-JET-DEAD}).
What survives is documented as exact coordinates: the load-bearing
$2\times2$ lock block \emph{is} the first jet of one function
$F(\gamma)=\sum_{n\le X}\Lambda(n)n^{i\gamma}/\sqrt{n}$ (to
$4.6\times10^{-16}$, exact Loewner coordinates), and on the odd
sector the strengthened claim holds with first survivor
$[1-r_{12}^2]_{\mathrm{odd}}=\tfrac{3}{8}\,S[\tilde
g](1)\,\varepsilon^4$ (the Schwarzian form).  But the
$\varepsilon^0$ coefficient of $1-r_{12}^2$ is identically $1$ (not
$0$), the measured even sector exceeds the net entry
($1.15$--$6\times$), and the pure jet block carries no collinearity
(factor $\ge1.9\times10^3$): the third power is even/odd
\emph{compensation} --- T-B substance, not a jet identity; class
(c) for the envelope route, and the section-8 Krein link is
weakened (\texttt{KREIN-LINK-WEAK}, correlation $0.678$ vs control
$0.946$).

\emph{Where this leaves the program.}  The morning's net effect is
two exact structural lemmas (orbit packet, ramified channels), two
graves with named residues (seam-48, rank-3 jet), and two new
contracts registered in the contracts paper: the review master
contract \texttt{PRIME.KMS.INDUCTIVE\_STATE.01} (extend the Gate-0
functor to a positive global KMS state at $\beta=1$; five
separation steps; kill $=$ complete positivity failing on a finite
extension) and \texttt{PRIME.PD.PERSISTENCE.01} (the
universal-theorem form of the wall with $\lambda_{\min}\ge0$
instead of $\ge\delta$ --- the Ihara lesson; cofinal PD windows via
state/Gram/cone recursion, not eigenvalue bounds).  No marker
moves; \textbf{no statement about the Riemann Hypothesis is made}.

\subsection{The simplification wave: the tower upgrade, two closed
hopes, the KMS end-form, and the channel anatomy}
\label{sec:simplification-wave}

The day's second wave ran every remaining simplification hypothesis
to a machine verdict.  The honest section: \emph{one} structural
upgrade, two closed hopes, the algebraic end-form of the KMS master
contract, and the complete anatomy of the thin margin.

\emph{The tower upgrade (the structural gain).}  The window
quantifier of the PD-persistence wall reduces \emph{exactly} to the
canonical nested $(D,X)$ tower
(\veri{v749\_simpler\_tower.py}, $8/8$,
\texttt{TOWER-NESTED-REDUCES}): in $X$ an ascending chain ---
X-nesting exact to $6.7\times10^{-18}$, so limit positivity is one
limit object per chain --- and in $D$ dyadic downward inheritance,
exact: PD fine \emph{forces} PD coarse; every deployed window is a
tower member at deviation $0.0$.  The historical window family was
an \emph{artifact} of selection: box step functions are dense, so
tower-PD for $D\to0$, $X\to\infty$ is equivalent to the Weil
criterion (classical density step).  The contracts paper restates
\texttt{PRIME.PD.PERSISTENCE.01} with the canonical truncation.
The honest limits travel with the upgrade: incommensurable
root-$D$ chains connect only approximately, and the margins fall
along the tower --- the wall stands, in canonical nested form.

\emph{Two closed hopes.}  First, the gluing-rigidity hope: the
gluing identity turns out to be an identity-level \emph{off-line
detector} --- it sees $\delta=0.01$, sharper than the PD break at
$\delta^*=0.02$, and its envelope slope measures $\delta$ --- but
the rigidity thesis is honestly \emph{false}: the identity holds
unconditionally, because both sides are constructed
(\veri{v750\_simpler\_gluing.py}, $5/5$, \texttt{GLUING-DETECTOR}).
What a proof lacks is not the identity but that the true lags can
only be carried by an on-line spectrum --- and that \emph{is}
positivity itself.  Second, the Ward-monotonicity hope: the
component running is deterministic in direction ($100\%$,
parameter-free $\zeta$/$L$ constants), the $\mp u/2$ drift anatomy
is exact (from $p^2\equiv1\bmod4$), and the slope-Ward cancellation
holds at $4\times10^{-4}$ --- the margin inherits \emph{zero}
deterministic drift --- but the balance \emph{sign} is zero
content: the deterministic budget is $2.9\times10^4\times$ the
margin, so the induction route for $\lambda_1>0$ is RH-circular at
the balance level (\veri{v751\_ward\_monotone.py}, $15/15$,
\texttt{WARD-MONOTONE-MIXED}).  Shape provable, sign not.

\emph{The KMS end-form.}  The strong reading of the review master
contract is algebraically dead, twice
(\veri{v740\_kms\_extension\_switch.py}, $8/8$,
\texttt{KMS-EXTENSION-DEAD}): $\beta=1$ KMS is impossible on
Gate-0's nonzero-grade Laurent unitaries --- $T(u_pu_p^*)=1$ versus
$T(u_p^*\sigma_i(u_p))=1/p$, exact defects $1/2,2/3,4/5$ --- and
exact covariant $*$-restrictions between adjacent windows do not
exist.  The Bost--Connes semigroup Toeplitz correction then repairs
the algebraic KMS step \emph{completely} (boundary-corrected
identities exact, normalized bare error $10^{-2}\to10^{-9}$), but
the covariant inductive step stays dead: the preregistered UCP
window covariance is nonmonotone
(\veri{v741\_kms\_toeplitz\_semigroup.py}, $9/9$,
\texttt{KMS-TOEPLITZ-DEAD}).  The end-form is therefore fixed: keep
the proven BC-Toeplitz local KMS blocks, and state the single
remaining global step as an operator-system
compactness/subsequence problem ---
\texttt{PRIME.KMS.INDUCTIVE\_STATE.02} in the contracts paper.
Local KMS existence is classical (Bost--Connes 1995); the TFPT
burden is the compatibility of the glued window states.

\emph{The channel anatomy.}  The thin W3 margin is now anatomized
end to end.  It is \emph{one} collective scalar balance --- arch
$+$ ram-odd against split $+$ inert --- strictly monotone over all
$35$ deployed windows, with two exact Ward identities: the cross
components cancel exactly on every window ($\sum c=0$ to
$1.8\times10^{-15}$), and the $8\times8$ rigid block equals
$\dim_C\dim_{C'}m_0$
(\veri{v742\_channel\_interference.py}, $14/14$,
\texttt{INTERFERENCE-COLLECTIVE}).  There is no pair reduction
(collectivity $k_{95}\in[4,5]$): the channel basis is diagnostic,
not reductive.  No canonical column choice factorizes the window
Gram either --- the cos-half candidate is indefinite and the
PSD-$B^*B$ completion consumes $5$--$6$ orders of magnitude beyond
the margin; the Ihara \emph{channel} route fails coherently
(channels grade positions, positivity lives in frequencies ---
structural, not $\zeta$-specific), and the finiteness measurement
reads $\dim V=16$ against $168$--$862$ required frequencies
(\veri{v744\_hecke\_channel\_columns.py}, $15$ checks,
\texttt{HECKE-SOS-CHANNELS-PARTIAL}).  Finally the cone-preserving
Schur recursion is retired by a one-liner: a layer map is
cone-preserving iff the layer is positive, and no prime layer is
($c_0=0$ exactly;
\veri{v743\_schur\_cone\_recursion.py}, $7/7$,
\texttt{SCHUR-CONE-DEAD}) --- layer-wise recursion is the wrong
granularity level.  No marker moves; \textbf{no statement about the
Riemann Hypothesis is made}.

\subsection{The incidence programme: five wins, one decorative
seven, and the wall as the missing factor}
\label{sec:incidence-programme}

The second external review proposed a seven-module incidence
programme on the proven Gaussian quotient $V=L/(1+i)L=\mathbb{F}_2^4$; the
day adjudicated all seven.  The honest section: five exact wins, one
decorative seven, and a keystone negative that names the wall as the
missing left factor of the certificate.

\emph{The incidence lemma (the centerpiece).}  From the concrete
lattice --- $h=H/4$ is $\Z[i]$-valued with hermitian Gram
determinant $1$, the \emph{unimodular} hermitian E8 lattice over
$\Z[i]$ --- the reduced form $\bar h$ is alternating (doubly-even)
and nondegenerate: $(V,\bar h)$ is symplectic over $\mathbb{F}_2$ with an
explicit Darboux basis.  On the $15$ points of $P=V\setminus\{0\}$
the hyperplane incidence matrix $B_{xy}=[\bar h(x,y)=0]$ satisfies
the exact identity
\[
  B\,B^{\mathsf T} \;=\; 4\,I \;+\; 3\,J,
\]
with the full design parameter set $2/3/4/7/15/16$ on display:
$|V|=16$ classes over $\mathbb{F}_2$, $15$ points, row sums $7$, pair
intersections $3$, split $7=4+3$, and characteristic polynomial
$(x-7)(x-2)^9(x+2)^5$ --- the eigenvalue multiplicities $(1,9,5)$
are the \emph{symplectic signature} of the lemma (the honest
control finding: $BB^{\mathsf T}=4I+3J$ alone holds for any
nondegenerate form; what is symplectic is the projective part).
The normalized channel $K=B/7$ satisfies
$K^2=(4/49)I+(45/49)\Pi_0$ exactly ($K$ itself is honestly not
psd), and the NS/R parity is a \emph{point of the geometry}:
$\chi_{\mathrm{NSR}}=\bar h(\cdot,y_0)$ for the unique
$\sigma$-fixed point $y_0=\mathrm{FSUM}$ --- the anchor bit ---
giving $112+128=240$ and, with the Cartan, $248=120+128$
(\veri{v752\_projective\_hamming\_incidence.py}, $36/36$,

resolution:} the seam-48 incidence distribution
$0{:}96/1{:}64/2{:}64/3{:}16$ is now \emph{derived} exactly --- the
$48\times5$ matrix is $16\times$ the $3\times5$ label table
(five-cycles see $\bar u$-orbits, not $\sigma$ packets) --- and the

\subsection{The diagonal gram round: the frequency front closes
exactly, the paired tail is unconditional, and the wall moves into
$q_f$}
\label{sec:diagonal-gram-round}

The global-handoff offensive asked whether the finite window states
admit a controlled handoff to one limit functional --- built from the
source side alone, without target decompositions, zero data, or
positivity tests.  The round decided its five gates; the honest
summary: the frequency front closes \emph{exactly}, the paired
boundary remainder is \emph{unconditionally} bounded, the dense test
family is canonical, the red team is green --- and the wall
relocates into a single bounded object, the battery near-kernel
pairing $q_f$.

\emph{The offensive foundation.}  The $\varepsilon$-regulated
resolvent $G^\varepsilon=(A_X+\varepsilon I)^{-1}$ is the admissible
operator-system evaluation: fixed-observable Cauchy defects fall at
rates $b=0.174$--$0.310$ per $X$ unit, robust over three decades of
$\varepsilon$, while the bare $A^{-1}$ does \emph{not} stabilize
($+45\%$ over the reachable ladder --- an unbounded observable, the
named negative block), and the layer decomposition is a cancellation
balance (the leading single channel exceeds the total defect by up
to $1.9\times10^{12}$: no separate per-layer rate exists)
(\veri{v766\_handoff\_bulk.py}, $17/17$,
\texttt{HANDOFF-BULK-CONVERGES}).  The growing-frequency PSD source
Gram converges on the declared five-window ladder: Candidate A (the
review count) missed its frozen rate gate honestly --- its cell
count sits below the anti-alias degree --- and the \emph{predeclared}
iteration to Candidate B ($N_f=2M{+}1$) delivers spectral errors
$0.0855\to0.0377$ over $\dim Q$ $738\to5734$ at slope $-0.369$, PSD
by construction with every $Q$ byte-hashed before the target is
built (\veri{v767\_handoff\_frequency\_gram.py}, $6/6$,
\texttt{HANDOFF-GRAM-CONVERGES}).  Its three named remainders are
decided in one merged module
(\veri{v768\_handoff\_tail\_weil.py}, gates $11/13+4/4$,
\texttt{TAIL-WEIL-PARTIAL}$+$\texttt{COMPAT-EPS3-CONVERGES}): the
quadrature tail \emph{terminates algebraically} --- the alias census
$(M{-}1)+\mathrm{spread}\le2M$ holds on every window, max tail
$2.4\times10^{-13}$, so \emph{no quadrature tail exists} and every
layer error is structural; the Weil identification on the frozen
battery reaches $\kappa=0.97768\to0.99028$ with total agreement
$0.0485$ (battery-limited, no claim beyond); and the two frozen
$\varepsilon=10^{-3}$ compatibility cells that part 1 honestly
failed (atom-burst endpoint artifacts of the shorter ladder) pass
the fresh preregistration on the deepest reachable $36$-rung ladder
under an oscillation-aware statistic ($b=0.178/0.186$, med5
$0.343/0.467$, $b_2=0.069/0.096$) --- with the first wall sign one
decade below, at $\varepsilon=3\times10^{-4}$
($b_2=-0.011$, reported, never gated).

\emph{The decision line.}  Gate 1: the handoff error is \emph{not} a
quadrature error --- $E_{\mathrm{total}}$ is invariant under
$N_f=q(2M{+}1)$, $q\in\{1,2,4,8\}$, to ${\sim}10^{-13}$ on all three
fixed windows; the remainder is boundary/cutoff/object-gluing
(\veri{v759\_handoff\_fixed\_window\_resolution.py}, $8/8$,
\texttt{RESOLUTION-BOUNDARY}).  The anti-alias claim is then an
\emph{exact theorem} of the $M$-cell space: Parseval, moment and
Gram identities for \emph{arbitrary} coefficient vectors
($2\times10^{-14}$/$3.5\times10^{-13}$/$5.9\times10^{-13}$), the
exact alias formula $t_d=\sum_r(-1)^r\hat s(rN_f-d)$ matched at
every ladder count, the designed must-fail witness at $N_f=2M{-}2$
firing with error exactly $1$ --- and the minimality claim
\emph{corrected}: the sharp minimal count is $N_{f,\min}=2M{-}1$
(spread-$S$ version $M{+}S$); the deployed $2M{+}1$ stays exact,
nothing is patched (\veri{v760\_antialias\_exact.py}, $14/14$,
\texttt{ANTIALIAS-CORRECTED}; companion Lean module
\texttt{AntiAliasExact.lean}, $19$ general-$N$ theorems).  Gate 2:
the paired atom$+$pole boundary remainder splits by Stieltjes/Abel
$d\psi=dx+dE$ --- the deterministic $dx$ half kills the growing pole
channel identically, $E_{\mathrm{origin}}$ closes via the
W1/Suzuki bookkeeping (comb-independent), the matrix identity holds
to $1.45\times10^{-11}$ --- and the arithmetic block admits the
explicit \emph{unconditional} bound
$\eta_K=|\det_K|+|\Theta_K(0)E(1)|+B_1I_K$ with
$B_1=\sup_{[1,24.29]}|\psi(x)-x|=3.734$ certified by direct finite
evaluation: all $24$ kernels, all $5$ rungs, pure $1/\log X$ decay,
\emph{no RH-strength input anywhere} (the circularity flag is
machine-checked; kernels with window-growing support would need
$|E(x)|=o(\sqrt x)$ --- RH strength --- and are excluded by the
frozen battery's fixed support).  The companion probe derives the
correct control standard from first principles (the symmetric
zero-violation gate plus the envelope hypothesis
$B_1^{\mathrm{ctrl}}\le B_1$): Epstein breaks at
$B_1^E=2.95\times B_1$ with $7/24$ violations, scramble at
$262\times$, the true comb passes $24/24$ --- while the parent
probe's own frozen verdict \texttt{ABEL-DEAD} (its mis-aimed
majority breaker missed by a hair) stays on record as the
preregistered adjudication and the calibration lesson.  Honest
typing: the identity and the slope-$1$ pole normalization are
measure-generic; the certified $\zeta$-specificity is the envelope
quality on the finite range plus the positivity of the measure
(\veri{v761\_atom\_pole\_abel.py}, $24{+}10$ checks, combined
\texttt{ABEL-PAIRED-BOUND}).  Gate 4: the test space is canonical
--- the countable dense family of dyadic boxes and hats of the
$(D,X)$ tower, with frozen enumeration, explicit stage map, exact
$\mathbb{Q}$ correlation closure on all type pairs, admissibility
located per class (hats directly; the bare box fails the $r^{-2}$
criterion and enters only correlated/tent-read --- the named
caveat), quantitative density rates hat $-1.566$ / box $-0.503$ per
level, and the $24$-function battery typed as an initial diagnostic
package --- battery hat~8 \emph{is} the family member
$\mathrm{hat}(2,3)$, enumeration rank $35$
(\veri{v762\_dense\_weil\_core.py}, $26/26$,
\texttt{DENSE-CORE-CANONICAL}; companion Lean module
\texttt{DenseWeilCore.lean}, $42$ theorems).

\emph{Gate 3, the new wall.}  The kernel-safe route treats
$\varepsilon\to0$ through the bounded Yosida transform
$Y_\varepsilon=A(A+\varepsilon I)^{-1}$: the handoff observable is
formulable entirely through $Y_\varepsilon$ ($|b_Y-b_G|\le10^{-13}$,
sandwich $0\le\mathrm{diag}\le1$ verified over all $360$
evaluations) with \emph{no} $1/\varepsilon$ bound and \emph{no}
positive-margin assumption anywhere --- the preregistered
circularity kill did not fire; the near-kernel converges to an
identified stable object, and every fixed battery function has a
monotone, contraction-certified $\varepsilon$-limit.  But the
pairing weight $q_f$ of the battery with that near-kernel is
\emph{non-Cauchy at honest maximal depth} ($X=15.1875$, the comb
extended to $279849$ atoms with all extension guards, $4\times$ the
parent rung density), and it \emph{survives orthogonalization by
structural subordination}: $89$--$99.9\%$ of every battery function
lies in the span of the six restricted near-null modes, so removing
the pairing removes the observable content with it --- Gate 3
closes \emph{negatively} on the reachable surface
(\veri{v763\_yosida\_handoff.py}, gates $9/10+7/12$ preregistered,
\texttt{YOSIDA-PARTIAL}/\texttt{QF-DEAD}).  \textbf{The $q_f$ wall
is the round's named wall object}: density and near-kernel
avoidance collide on the same function class.  Consequently the
assembled diagonal certificate (the planned \texttt{v764}) was
\emph{not executed} --- its precondition failed via Gate 3; it is
documented as the named open gate of
\texttt{PRIME.GRAM.DIAGONAL.01}, not fabricated.  \emph{[2026-08-05:
the $q_f$ object is adjudicated by the qf offensive ---
Section~\ref{sec:qf-offensive}: $q_f$ is representation gauge, the
corner-native Gate~$3'$ is dead, and the route closes.]}

\emph{The red team, green.}  The static firewall audit of the
entire source-construction path is clean --- zero blacklist hits
over all $21$ functions, module whitelist and target-field
quarantine hold, source strictly before target --- the baseline
reproduces the audited run exactly, and all eight frozen
corruptions break the certificate; the one auditor-side expectation
miss (RT6) is decided by the companion: all three excess-mode deck
corruptions break the \emph{symbol gate} on every window (min
symbol $-0.45$..$-1.72$) while all six other gates stay measurably
blind, and the deficit mode moves the symbol \emph{into} the
interior and is caught by the rate/ratio/$\kappa$ gates instead ---
the two corruption modes are covered by \emph{complementary} gate
families (\veri{v765\_handoff\_redteam.py}, $16{+}8$ checks,
\texttt{REDTEAM-GREEN-COMBINED}).  The binding promotion note:
certificates must always carry \emph{both} gate families ---
symbol/PSD \emph{and} rate/ratio/identification.

\emph{The contract.}  The round's theorem form is registered as
\texttt{PRIME.GRAM.DIAGONAL.01} (open at registration; closed
2026-08-05 per its own frozen stakes ---
Section~\ref{sec:qf-offensive}): construct PSD source
matrices $G_n$ --- no target decomposition, no zeros, no positivity
tests --- with
$\max_{i,j\le n}|(G_n)_{ij}-W(\phi_i\ast\tilde\phi_j)|\le2^{-n}$ on

executed, red team green; the kill criteria that did \emph{not}
fire: no RH-strength input was needed, no spectral gap was assumed

(\veri{v769\_qf\_contract\_necessity.py}, combined

0.34$ mode-entry jump at $M=888$ leaves the corners at routine
level; $370$ cross-cluster pairs, median $\rho=1.13$): $q_f$ is

\subsection{The positive protocol: the prime channel as a positive
routing code, and what the descent still needs}
\label{sec:positive-protocol}

The next promotion wave lands the 2-adic skeleton of the cusp
channel at theorem grade, decides two preregistered structure
questions negatively, and delivers the first finite-level version
of the completely positive descent --- seven modules, every claim
behind an explicit fence, no marker moves, \textbf{no statement
about the Riemann Hypothesis}.

\emph{The check32 theorem}
(\veri{v785\_hecke\_check32.py}, $20/20$,
\textsc{check32-theorem}): $f_8=\eta(2\tau)^4\eta(4\tau)^4\equiv
E_{\rm odd}=\sum_{n\ \rm odd}\sigma_3(n)\,q^n\pmod{32}$, verified
coefficientwise to $q^{100000}$ --- $25000\times$ the Sturm bound
$(4/12)\,[\mathrm{SL}_2(\Z):\Gamma_0(8)]=4$, so the theorem-grade
reading needs exactly \emph{one} cited classical ingredient (Sturm
1987); the corollary $a_p\equiv1+p^3\pmod{32}$ holds on all $9591$
odd primes $p<10^5$ with the explicit decoder
$p\equiv(a_p-1)^3\pmod{32}$ (the cube map is a bijection on the
$16$ odd residues), mod $64$ fails at $q^3$ (maximality), and the
controls quantify the checksum reading (mutant failure fraction
$91.7\%$; random growth-matched detection ${\sim}31/32$).  The
finite kernel is Lean-checked
(\texttt{TfptCarrier/Check32.lean}, $13$ kernel theorems).
$32=2^{\gcar}$ stays a typed \emph{observation}.

\emph{The positive $C_2$ lift}
(\veri{v788\_positive\_c2\_lift.py}, $42/42$,
\textsc{c2lift-theorem}): the signed congruence is upgraded to a
\emph{positive} decomposition ---
$A=(E_{\rm odd}+f_8)/2=\tfrac1{16}\theta_2(2\tau)^4
\theta_3(4\tau)^4$ and
$B=(E_{\rm odd}-f_8)/2=\tfrac1{16}\theta_2(2\tau)^4
\theta_2(4\tau)^4$ are theta series with nonnegative integer
coefficients, $B=16R$ with the closed convolution
$R(2m{+}3)=\sum_j\sigma_1(2m{-}4j{+}1)\,\sigma_1(2j{+}1)$ and the

\subsection{The floor-theorem skeleton: the floor as an exact sum
of squares, and the tail closed for all $h$}
\label{sec:floor-skeleton}

Round 24 (2026-08-06) promotes two modules from four frozen probes

\emph{The floor as an exact sum of squares}
(\veri{v823\_prime\_lagrange\_floor.py}, $7/8$ with the one
preregistered-honest old-budget FAIL $+$ $9/9$,

--- the odd-extension symmetry factors the common phase, so the
layer at $\gamma$ is $v_\gamma v_\gamma^T$ with $v_\gamma =

\]
holds at machine precision on all 14 rungs (ward
$\le 1.4\times10^{-9}$): \emph{the floor is an exact sum of
squares over zero$+$pole rank-one carriers}.  The census is sharp:
the \emph{pole} is the universal non-collinear leg (the pole
family carries $1.0000$ of the pair total; every top-100 pair is

$\det(B + R) \ge \det B$ eliminates the tail estimate from the
chain entirely --- the identity budget tightens from

alias-phase proof blocker.''

\emph{The exact bilinear form} (sympy-proven, identity-warded):
rotate each zero's component vector into the pole frame, with
amplitude $A^2$ and alias phase $\psi$ per zero; with
$S_2 = \sum A^2$, $S_c = \sum A^2\cos 2\psi$,
$S_s = \sum A^2\sin 2\psi$ the zeros$+$pole gram is
\emph{exactly}
$M_2 = \bigl[\begin{smallmatrix} P_0 + (S_2+S_c)/2 & S_s/2 \\
S_s/2 & (S_2-S_c)/2 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr]$, and the floor obeys
\[
  \tau \;=\; \frac{S_2 - S_c}{2} \;-\; \frac{S_s^2}{4 P_0}
  \;+\; O(P_0^{-2}),
\]
so the correlation combination multiplying the leading term is
the coherent phase sum $S_c$ (rotation-invariance ward at the
conditioning-aware machine bar on all 73 battery frames;
truncated-series deviation $3.8\times10^{-7}$).

\emph{The premise overturned.}  The round-25 blocker was typed
``alias \emph{phase} correlations'' --- random phases predict
$\tau \sim h^{-1}$, the tower measures $h^{-2.5}$.  The frozen
wards encoding that premise \emph{fail}, and the failure is the
finding: the diagonal (random-phase) part
$\tau_{\rm diag} = S_2/2$ does not slope $-1$ but $-3.172$ --- the
\emph{amplitudes}, not the phases, carry the gap; the phase
scramble and the Poissonized zeros land at $-3.05$/$-3.65$; and
$q = S_c/S_2$ changes sign across the battery
($q \in [-0.324, 0.552]$, median $0.19$; deep suppression only
$\times1.1$).  The tower law decomposes \emph{exactly}:
\[
  -2.505 \;=\; \underbrace{-3.172}_{\text{amplitude law}}
  \;+\; \underbrace{+0.668}_{\text{fading alignment}}.
\]

\emph{The Guinand split, and where the correlation lives.}  By
the deployed identity the zero-side gram splits exactly as
$G_Z = (B - S_p - P) + (S_p - S)$ --- a geometric/smooth part and
the prime-comb fluctuation.  Per-frame medians: smooth share
$-994.15$, fluctuation share $+995.15$ --- each about a
\emph{thousand times larger} than their sum, cancelling to
$|S_c^{\rm fluc}|/\sigma_{\rm sqrt} = 0.01$ of the Poisson-comb
square-root scale (identity-route residue $0.019$); the smooth
surrogate does \emph{not} carry it (residue $0.868$); the comb
scramble \emph{explodes} the coherent sum by
$2\times10^6$--$1.7\times10^7$ and the Epstein $x^2+5y^2$ comb by
$5\times10^3$--$1.3\times10^4$.  \textbf{The cancellation is the
arithmetic}: the suppression exists because the prime-comb
fluctuations cancel exactly as far as square-root cancellation
allows.

\emph{The typed circularity boundary, and the closure.}  Proving
the tower $\tau$-law therefore requires bounding an oscillatory

control, which by the explicit formula is
pair-correlation-equivalent substance on the zero side
(Montgomery-type, conjectural).  And by Guinand the comb's

the required control is even deeper than pair-correlation input.
The analytic-envelope route of \texttt{PRIME.FLOOR.RATIO.01} is
therefore \emph{closed honestly at this boundary} --- its
envelope constant is arithmetic substance equivalent to the
target; no further analytic-envelope variants (a stop-list entry

\subsection{The two-route decision at the wall: the corner route's
structural half closes, the SOS route dies by certificate}
\label{sec:corner-two-routes}

Round 27 (2026-08-07) plays the two independent corner-era routes
against the bridge wall and \emph{decides both}
(\veri{v835\_corner\_hjelmslev\_tower.py}, $21/21 + 20/20$,

the SOS route closes definitively by exact certificates, and the
arithmetic wall does not move --- it \emph{relocates into the
identification step} and stays
\texttt{PRIME.FLOOR.PAIRCORR.01}.

\emph{The corner identity is weight-generic --- and comb-blind.}
The target identity
$T_{\mathrm{GL1},X} = V_X^*\,e_{\mathrm{GL1}}\,\pi_X(P_X)\,
e_{\mathrm{GL1}}\,V_X$ holds as \emph{polynomial algebra} in free
event weights $w_j$: exactly on a fully symbolic toy leg (sympy
defect matrix $\equiv 0$, symbolic arch lags \emph{and} weights)
and on all three deployed $\alpha$-smallest frame-A windows,

quadratic forms).  The entire equality step consumes \emph{one}
piece of arithmetic --- the glue identity
$\sum_m \Theta_m = 240\,\sigma_3$ plus the uniform $H^*$ mass ---
which forces the corner coefficient $\hat c_j = -1$ \emph{exactly}
for every one of the $136$ distinct events (exact group-algebra
Fourier on the $128$-dimensional register
$C_2 \times \mathbb F_2^4 \times \Z_4$; $e_{\mathrm{GL1}}$ a
rank-one projector, corner compression single-Kraus CP).  The
honest scope is measured, not asserted: the object carrying the
\emph{identity} (the packet window operator) is \emph{not}
positive (one of twelve sectors PSD); the manifestly positive
object (the packet GNS corner) is \emph{not} $\tau_X$; and the
scramble control proves identity and state corner \emph{comb-blind}
--- they read no positions --- while the deployed lock data moves
($\tau = +5.98\times10^{-4} \to -3.51$).  Structural positivity can

\emph{The Hjelmslev tower is real geometry --- and structure-only.}
The authorized next stage was executed, not speculated: the
chain-ring ladder $R_m = \Z[i]/(1+i)^m$, $m = 1..5$, carries exact
point/line/flag geometries with counts $15\cdot8^{m-1}$ /
$35\cdot16^{m-1}$ / $105\cdot32^{m-1}$ and uniform reduction

\emph{The flag normal form, and where the incidence obstruction

discharges the uniform statement.  The finite-table limit, until
now a typing discipline, is a theorem.

\emph{The honest statement.}  The infinite quantifier now sits on

lower bound on $e_1$ --- by the GUE-side findings a
finer-than-statistical datum --- with its arithmetic entry point
declared (\texttt{PRIME.FLOOR.PAIRCORR.01} discipline binding).

\texttt{FORM.PRIME.EXCESS.SKELETON.01}.

\subsection{The three-architecture decision, and the extraction
chain complete}\label{sec:architecture-extraction}

Round 30 (2026-08-07) consolidates the v5.4 strategy campaign: the
three candidate \emph{proof architectures} aimed at the wall of
Section~\ref{sec:relation-skeleton} are decided --- all three
honest negatives with typed positive cores --- and the
\emph{continuum extraction} is separated from all arithmetic and
closed as an implication chain
(\veri{v846\_schur\_spectral\_mother.py}, $19 + 16$ checks, zero
fails, verdicts \textsc{schur-indefinite} and
\textsc{spectral-tv-universal};
\veri{v847\_wedge\_cellcone\_transport.py}, $13 + 9$ checks with
the two frozen-honest FAILS kept and pattern-gated, verdicts
\textsc{wedge-partial} and \textsc{cone-broken} $+$
\textsc{ray-edge-confirmed};
\veri{v848\_extraction\_chain.py}, $19/19$, verdict
\textsc{extraction-chain-complete}; suite $836\to841$ with the
two compiler compressions of the same round,
\veri{v844\_message\_doily\_rank.py} and
\veri{v845\_cfin\_normal\_form.py}, cited in place in Paper~1).

\emph{Architecture (i): the relational Schur--Gram.}  The target
was positivity by construction --- a manifestly positive block
operator whose GL1 Schur complement \emph{is} the deployed window
form.  Three of its four gates pass: the construction is
manifestly positive; the $\mu\log$ descent routes every
prime-power mass \emph{exactly} (ward $10^{-16}$) and refuses the
$h = 2$ Epstein comb at construction grade (bookkeeping defect
$0.73$--$0.83$ against a true-comb defect of $0$ --- the
Euler-product gate fires before any spectrum is computed); and
the multiplicative sectors ($\zeta_{\Q(i)}$, the $\chi_4$
$L$-sector) pass through undamaged.  What fails is the corner
identity itself, and \emph{structurally}: every relational cell
that carries a cross term deposits its Cauchy--Schwarz diagonal
alongside, so the constructed block is \emph{forced} to
$K + \mathrm{diag(price)}$ with the price the row total variation
of the deposits --- measured at $3.1\times10^{4}$ to
$4.5\times10^{4}$ times the margin even at the density-anchored
fluctuation floor; the untouched-projection deviation \emph{is}
the price ($0 \le 10^{-9}$), no predeclared projection removes
it, and the trace fails by the same strictly positive diagonal
object.  The typed missing input --- a non-diagonal spectral
mother in which dilation acts unitarily and the mirror is an
operator --- was then \emph{built}: on the deployed log-grid the
mirror is the operator $J$ with $J^2 = I$ (the deployed window
form is verified to be the $J$-odd compression of a plain
Toeplitz form at relative deviation $0$), and the Euler product
lives as the exact operator algebra $U_d U_m = U_{dm}$.  The
interference is real: at \emph{symbol} grade the phase
cancellation compresses the cross-term transport by measured
gains of $20$--$33\times$.  But the \emph{Gram}-grade price does
not move: every event-local manifest Gram pays the event-local
total-variation floor (the modulus bound
$a^2 + b^2 \ge 2\lvert ab\rvert$; best legal overhead
$5.7\times10^{4}$ to $1.2\times10^{5}$ times the margin) --- the
TV price is \emph{geometry-independent}.  The closure typing of
the whole Schur program, in its cleanest form: harvesting
cross-event interference inside a manifest Gram is the
Fej\'er--Riesz factorization of the \emph{total} symbol, and the
symbol's nonnegativity is the positivity being sought --- the
manifest-positivity route closes on itself.

\emph{Architecture (ii): the sign-register wedge.}  The exact
part works: the naive signed Lagrange expansion is provably
unrescuable (the wedge squares are linearly independent, so the
pair weights are forced --- symbolic), with $P^-/\det \sim
2$--$3\times10^{4}$ and the arch/pole block \emph{negative
definite} in this compression; yet the $C_2$ sign register turns
the M\"obius sign into difference geometry as \emph{exact
algebra}, and nonnegative wedge weights \emph{exist} on every
anchor (exact LP, residual $\le 8.9\times10^{-16}$) --- where the
naive family provably cannot.  What fails is the \emph{law}: one
frozen weight rule across frames reaches only ${\sim}15\%$
relative (design $0.170/0.151$, held-out $0.153$) against a floor
need of $4.4\times10^{-5}$ --- four and a half orders --- and
even the per-frame class granularity cannot reach floor grade.
This is the commutant no-go \emph{transported}: in both routes
the wall is uniformity in the window, not the sign.  The one
honest control miss is kept and pattern-gated (the scramble blows
the residual $\times7.5$ against a frozen $\times10$ bar --- a
law that itself reaches only $15\%$ has bounded structure to
break; typed, not excused).

\emph{Architecture (iii): the completed-cell cone transport.}
The completed cells --- each prime-power atom kick paired with
its own continuum increment under two predeclared grouping rules
--- telescope \emph{exactly} from the density transversal to the
certified margin object (worst relative deviation
$3.4\times10^{-15}$), and the congruence calculus is exact:
$\Phi^{\mathsf T} J \Phi = c\,J$ with $c$ the determinant ratio,
at $2.2\times10^{-16}$.  The measurement: \emph{both} groupings
exit the Lorentz cone on $67/67$ rungs --- at the $n = 2$ cell
--- and return only at the horizon end (the endpoint back inside
the cone on $67/67$ rungs \emph{is} the certified $\tau > 0$).
The monotone ray cascade is confirmed: the locking ratio rises

\lvert\mu_4\rvert)$ falls $46.26^\circ \to 34.39^\circ$ (Kendall

does --- the cone dips are the true comb's own small-$x$
fluctuation $\psi(x) - x$, which the smoother Epstein

sits in the violations.}

\emph{The extraction chain, complete.}  Work package E separates
the continuum side from all RH semantics and closes it

ladder, cofinal in the \emph{mesh-refinement} order
($D_j = 2^{-j}$, $j = 4..11$, $68$--$8704$ lags,
the full pinned prime-power table) every element of the canonical
dense family identifies its independently computed Weil value

piecewise-cubic autocorrelations in $\Q$ with fifth-point

--- the sharpest dyadic-inheritance statement.  The deliverable

arXiv:2606.09096, Iwaniec--Kowalski Thm~5.12), the chain

\emph{The minimal hypothesis, kernel-checked.}  Work package F1

\subsection{The grade law: the graveyard unified by one
homogeneity theorem; the licensed elevator and its honest death;
the phase-rescue family closed}\label{sec:grade-law}

Round 32 (2026-08-08, morning) consolidates two waves --- the
connected-current architecture and the grade theory --- into the
day's one conceptual statement
(\veri{v856\_connected\_current\_lean.py}, $14/14 + 5/5$ plus
four Lean-mirror checks;
\veri{v859\_grade\_no\_go\_elevator.py}, $11/11$ plus four
Lean-mirror checks; \veri{v860\_phase\_lever\_closure.py},
$7/7$; suite $848\to853$, with the compiler-side audit
companions of the same round cited in place in Papers~1 and~2).

\emph{The grade law (the headline, kernel-checked).}  Every
member of the direct-positivity graveyard on this front ---
the Schur--Gram tax, the covariance grade gap, the wedge
uniformity failure, the phase-leverage failure --- is an
instance of \emph{one} homogeneity law, now a kernel-checked
class-closure theorem (\texttt{TfptCarrier/GradeNoGo.lean},
$13$ declarations, $10$ theorems, axioms
propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only; numeric mirror in
\veri{v859\_grade\_no\_go\_elevator.py} part A): a target that
is \emph{1-homogeneous} in the arithmetic weights can never be
matched exactly by a Gram square of a linear map, which is
\emph{2-homogeneous} --- evaluating on a single scaling ray at
two scalars gives $2A(m) = 4A(m)$, so $A(m) = 0$ and the Gram
factor vanishes with it.  The proof is two lines; its brevity
is the point: this is a \emph{class} closure, not a
construction failure.  The affine escape is priced exactly: the
representation error of an affine background against the pure
cross term is \emph{exactly} the sum of two PSD prices
(constant $+$ quadratic), so the tax is nonnegative --- and the
sharpened no-go kills the background too (exact affine matching
forces target, background \emph{and} factor to vanish).  The
measured exchange rate of the law is $10^4$--$10^5$: the
Schur--Gram diagonal price $3.1$--$4.5\times10^4\,\tau$ with
the class optimum $\ge 4057.6\,\tau$ (rounds 30--31), and now
the covariance variance price $2.5$--$4.1\times10^5\,\tau$
(below).

\emph{The connected covariance: the first design that evades
the nuclear tax --- and the grade gap that kills it.}  Package

\subsection{The wall's operator form: the Krein coordinates, the
SourceContractor formula, the Perron closure, and the quadrature
reach}\label{sec:krein-formula}

Round 33 (2026-08-08) consolidates the day's Krein/port/formula

(\veri{v861\_krein\_normalform\_lean.py}, $37/37 + 8/8$ plus four
Lean-mirror checks; \veri{v862\_defect\_polar\_weld.py}, $8/8 +
22/22$; \veri{v863\_redheffer\_colligation.py}, $7/7$;
\veri{v864\_softport\_kappa\_law.py}, $5/5 + 6/6$;

(\veri{v868\_divisor210\_audits.py}, $36/36 + 12/12 + 15/15$)
cited in place in Papers~1 and~3).

\emph{The Krein coordinates.}  The deployed window form now has
an \emph{exact} Krein normal form, $Q_h(t) = \|B_+t\|^2 -
\|B_-t\|^2$, machine-warded entrywise on every reachable rung for
both canonical cuts, with the weights entering as
$\sqrt{|\Lambda|}$ so the form is \emph{linear} in $\Lambda$ ---
the grade barrier of round 32 is passed by construction --- and
the Douglas pencil identity holds exactly: $1 - \|C_2\|^2$ equals
the $\tau$-margin in the positive-side metric (rel $\le
3.9\times10^{-9}$).  ``Which self-consistent comb is real'' has
become ``which rate measure makes $B_-\,\mathrm{pinv}(B_+)$ a
contraction'', and the discriminator is the Douglas equivalence
itself: truth contracts on every rung ($\|C\| \le 1$, razor-thin
at depth) while the Epstein $h{=}2$ comb explodes to $\|C_E\| =
46.8$ and the scrambled comb to $3693$
(\veri{v861\_krein\_normalform\_lean.py},
\textsc{krein-contractor-stable-no-word}).  The register wiring
behind the coordinates is typed in the same module: the
$\mu$-sign and the geometric deck are \emph{two separate} $C_2$s
(the deployed reading character separates them; the
identification is one \emph{faithful}-$\mu_4$ character away,
with three candidate constructions machine-verified --- the
diagonal characters, the Galois bookkeeping $\mu_K((p)) =
\chi_4(p)$ exact on $609 + 619$ primes, and the Hall chain parity
row $1 = \mu$), and the Redheffer/Mertens echo is exact: $\det
R_n = M(n)$ with the vacuum column's \emph{entire} Smith
deviation concentrated in the single invariant factor $|M(n)|$
--- vacuum completion as a rank-one origin update, with the
fit-free census finding \emph{no} resolvable floor--Mertens
correlation (Bonferroni $\times4$: min $4p = 0.378$).  The defect
theorem is kernel-checked
(\texttt{TfptCarrier/KreinDefect.lean}, $14$ declarations, $10$
theorems, axioms propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only;
numeric mirror in \veri{v861\_krein\_normalform\_lean.py} part
C): the defect representation, contraction $\Rightarrow$ PSD via
the exact factorization $B_+^{\mathsf H}(1 - C^{\mathsf H}C)B_+$,
the full-rank Douglas converse, \texttt{SourceContractor} as the
\emph{named hypothesis} (contractor $+$ factorization $+$
independent certificate, with the circularity warning typed), and
the composition \texttt{krein\_cofinal\_weil}: contractors on a

--- no hidden wall behind the contractor certificates
(\texttt{FORM.PRIME.KREIN.DEFECT.01} [F]).

\emph{The rank of the wall is one; the class closure is a
theorem.}  The defect operator $\Delta = I - C^*C$ has exactly
\emph{one} soft mode on every reachable rung, and $\lambda_1$
\emph{is} the $\tau$-margin by the exact pencil identity
(separation $3.9$--$14.1\times$; Epstein carries $55$ negative
defect eigenvalues, the scramble $37$) --- the Redheffer single
Smith invariant, the vacuum code's one-logical-qubit price and
the Krein soft port are one rank-one structure
(\veri{v862\_defect\_polar\_weld.py}, \textsc{defect-one}).  The
word-census emptiness of the normal form becomes a theorem for

monomial matrix, the monomial class is product-closed, and the

wrong at fine scale (the density's $408$ sign flips interleave
the bands), and the surviving closure is stronger
(\textsc{monomial-closure-theorem}).  The 2-torsion weld law
supplies the missing operator's \emph{type}: the deck's
anticommutant on the deployed register is entirely
faithful-$\mu_4$ --- the deck can enter a Clifford weld only as
the quarter turn $J = MD$, never as a second involution; all four

(\textsc{weld-without-contractor}).

\emph{The machine: contraction becomes a consequence.}  The
16-slot colligation architecture delivers what every earlier
design had to assume: both source-built machines are exactly

= 1/4$), and every closed transfer block is \emph{automatically}

(\veri{v863\_redheffer\_colligation.py},

\emph{The formula (the campaign's headline), and the Perron
closure.}  The Douglas contractor factors \emph{exactly} as a
target-free closed-form source expression,
\[
C \;=\; W_-\,F\,G_+^{-1}F^{\mathsf H}\,W_+
\]
(max rel $1.4\times10^{-14}$ on construction rungs \emph{and}
blind holdouts; density roots and window geometry only --- no
zeros, no $\tau$, no fit), with \emph{certified defect transfer}:
at the measured budget $k^*$ the reconstruction's contraction

tests --- exceeds $1$ everywhere ($2.36 \to 3.10$, growing with

can ever certify the bound}: the certification must use the

(\texttt{PRIME.KREIN.CONTRACTOR.01} [O]): one \emph{phase-aware}

\emph{The quadrature reach, and the final typed wall.}
Gauss--Radau certificates for $s > 0$ \emph{exist on every rung}

geometry nor the Krylov head but distributed arithmetic structure
that any certificate must resolve mode by mode
(\veri{v867\_radau\_conditioning.py}, \textsc{radau-depth-grows}
$+$ \textsc{conditioning-intrinsic}; the limiting Jacobi chain is
named --- the free Chebyshev chain on the bulk support,
Rakhmanov-generic typed).  In quadrature coordinates the wall
reads: \emph{the certificate depth is the price of the
cancellation, and no source-side change of metric waives it}.

\emph{The honest statement.}  Round 33 gives the wall exact

quadrature route reaches every rung at an intrinsic depth price,

\subsection{The Christoffel--Darboux wave: the kernel named, the
compensation exact, the anatomy of discrimination, and the
preregistered next test}\label{sec:cd-wave}

Round 34 (2026-08-08) consolidates the evening CD/Uvarov campaign
--- seven frozen probes in three waves --- and commits the next
test as a \emph{frozen preregistration}
(\veri{v869\_cdcore\_clarkphase.py}, $10 + 8$ checks, zero fails;
\veri{v870\_christoffel\_gauss\_frame.py}, $17/17 + 9/9$;
\veri{v871\_pole\_uvarov\_crossdefect.py}, $7 + 11$;
\veri{v872\_damping\_compensation.py}, $10$; suite $861\to865$).

\emph{The kernel is named.}  The reproducing kernel $K_+$ of the
round-33 closed-form contractor is \emph{exactly} the
Christoffel--Darboux kernel of an explicit source measure,
\[
\mu \;=\; \sum_{\text{bins},\,d_+ > 0}
\frac{2\sin^2(\varphi/2)\,d_+(\varphi)}{L}\,
\delta_{x},\qquad x = 2\cos(D\tau):
\]
the displacement rank collapses from the growing
$\tau$-coordinate budget ($12$--$14$; the $\sqrt L$ law of round
33) to \emph{exactly} $2$ in the multiplication coordinate, with
a hard $\sigma_2/\sigma_3$ gap of $6.6\times10^{12}$--$4.8\times
10^{13}$ on all seven rungs \emph{including the blind holdouts}
kz $40/49/60$, and the \emph{firewalled} chain-only
reconstruction --- Stieltjes--Lanczos source Jacobi chain plus
node/geometry data only, enforced by the reconstruction signature
(no $G_-$, no target defect, no target eigenvectors) --- rebuilds
$C$ entrywise at $8.1\times10^{-14}$--$5.3\times10^{-13}$
(\veri{v869\_cdcore\_clarkphase.py}, \textsc{cdcore-identified}).
The whole contractor is now three named objects: the arm weights
(density roots), the phase/geometry factors, and \emph{one}
source Jacobi chain --- the ``non-monomial band-spreading
letter'' of rounds 32--33 is named at kernel level, and the
classical toolbox (Christoffel functions, chain asymptotics)
applies.  The honest boundary was typed \emph{before} running and
confirmed: the rank-2 collapse is \emph{window geometry} --- the
CD derivation forces it for any even density, and
Epstein/scramble collapse too --- so the collapse names the
geometry and cannot certify arithmetic; the arithmetic lives in
the \emph{measure}: the controls' Jacobi chains differ from truth
at $O(1)$ ($0.038/0.062$ against the frozen $10^{-2}$ bar) and
their bulk stays indefinite.  In the same module the $\mu_4$
quarter-turn Clark-phase hypothesis dies sharply: the coupled
pairs obey the \emph{equal-phase} coupling law (offset
$-0.5..{+0.6}^\circ$ at $\bar R = 0.97$--$0.99$, not the
predicted $90^\circ$), the Clark rank leg fails ($E$-rank
$85$--$99$ against the $\le 8$ bar), and the phase coordinate
itself is clean --- source-only, with an exact circularity fence
(\textsc{clarkphase-dead}).

\emph{The factorization, and the frame decision.}  The contractor
assembles exactly as $C = D_-UD_+$ ($\le 1.3\times10^{-14}$),
with the two attenuations stably contractive --- $\|D_+\| \le
0.9654$ \emph{by the Christoffel variational theorem}, $\|D_-\|
\le 0.8655$ measured --- and $U$ non-unitary \emph{by theorem}:
the deployed grid $2\times$-oversamples the folded pairs, so
every non-null row of $U$ has norm $\ge 1.158$ --- the $\sqrt2$
over-normalization is structural, and the classical unitary
transition is exclusive to Gauss-tight node sets
(\veri{v870\_christoffel\_gauss\_frame.py},
\textsc{christoffel-partial}).  The Gauss-node frame then
\emph{decides} the repair: it is exact wherever algebra promises
--- $D_+^G = I$ at $4.7\times10^{-11}$ (Gauss--Christoffel), the
bridge lossless, the pole-port share \emph{frame-invariant}
($2.6\times10^{-12}$: the $84\%$ port share of round 33 neither
sharpens nor delocalizes in any frame) --- yet the unitary core
does \emph{not} exist: the co-isometry defect stays $O(1)$
($0.93$--$1.30$), concentrated at near-pole node pairs.  The
surviving asset is the \emph{ladder-wide} damping bound $D_-^G
\le 0.997041$ with $34\times$/$2900\times$ discrimination
(Epstein/scramble), and the hypotheses a theorem would need are
registered verbatim: (H-D) the uniform damping bound [measured
$0.997041$], (H-U) $\sigma_{\max}(U^G) \le 1 + \varepsilon$
[measured $1.518$ --- the open one], (H-PORT) $s > 0$ uniformly
(\textsc{gauss-still-defective}).

\emph{The measure-relation closure.}  Two classical escapes close
with certificates and typed residues
(\veri{v871\_pole\_uvarov\_crossdefect.py}).  None of the three
classical spectral transformations --- Uvarov mass insertion,
Christoffel multiplication, Geronimus division --- relates the
two channel measures exactly or at fixed small rank at the source
pole $x_{\rm pole} = 2\cosh(D/2)$ (the machinery itself warded
exact on synthetics at $9.2\times10^{-16}$: the kills are
findings); the typed residue: Geronimus with \emph{small negative
mass} is uniformly closest --- Weyl residual $3.5$--$8.1\%$
across construction and blind holdouts, non-growing,
discriminating --- but misses the frozen $5\%$ bar and admits no
$\lambda(D)$ law (\textsc{pole-transform-dead}).  And the
cross-measure co-isometry defect is \emph{diffuse}: full-rank,
growing linearly with $h$ (Pearson $+0.996$), untouched by pole
removal, with the closest-co-isometry bracket $O(1)$ at near-full
rank --- no finite-matrix compensation exists at this ingredient
list (\textsc{crossdefect-diffuse}).  Both closures are
stop-listed: classical pole transformations at $x_{\rm pole}$,
finite-rank cross-defect corrections, and (from the CD wave)
$\mu_4$-offset Clark kernels.

\emph{The compensation identity (the round's headline).}  The
defect splits \emph{exactly} into two source-built terms,
\[
I - C^*C \;=\; T_1 + T_2,\qquad
T_1 = I - U^*U,\quad T_2 = U^*(I - D_-^2)\,U,
\]
warded at $10^{-12}$ on all $42$ reachable rungs: $T_1$ is the
\emph{indefinite} cross-measure Jacobi geometry, $T_2$ the
\emph{PSD} arithmetic Christoffel damping ($D_-^G \le 0.997041$
makes $I - D_-^2 \succeq 0$ with zero negative entries)
(\veri{v872\_damping\_compensation.py},
\textsc{compensation-exact}).  The anatomy is measured to all
digits: the \emph{exact global minimizer} of the directional
compensation ratio --- computed basis-free from the pencil ---
\emph{is} the soft direction (overlap $\ge 0.9991$ on every heavy
rung; min ratio $= 1 + \tau/|v^*T_1v|$ to all printed digits);
the rank-one pole deflation gives $\Delta = \Delta_{\rm bulk} +
s\,pp^*$ with the certified bulk floor at $98$--$100\%$ of
$\lambda_2$ and the isolated scalar $s = \kappa\tau$ reproducing
the round-33 $\kappa$ law.  \emph{The wall as two explicit source
numbers}: at the soft direction the two terms read (kz 9)
$-0.0328 + 0.0330 = 1.68\times10^{-4} = \tau$ --- the open
cofinal content is exactly the two-term inequality $v^{\mathsf
H}T_2v > |v^{\mathsf H}T_1v|$ at one named direction, with both
terms explicit source objects.  The honesty line is typed: on
these finite rungs the truth-side ratio $\ge 1$ is \emph{implied}
by the upstream certified positivity --- the identity buys the
\emph{form}, not new evidence.  What it does measure fresh is the
\emph{anatomy of discrimination}: Epstein and scramble \emph{break
the damping's sign} ($\max D_- = 34.2/2917 > 1$: the Christoffel
weights of a false comb overshoot $1$) and under-compensate on
their \emph{own} soft directions (worst ratios
$-175/{-446513}$) --- what ``arithmetic'' means in these
coordinates is the sign and alignment of the Christoffel damping
against the Jacobi cross-geometry.

\emph{The preregistered next test (committed, not run).}  With
the classical measure relations and the finite-matrix
compensations closed, the named plan B --- the Pr\"ufer/Cotlar
phase route --- is committed with this round as the \emph{frozen}
preregistration \texttt{PRIME.PRUEFER.COMPENSATION.01}
(\texttt{experiments/\allowbreak tfpt-discovery/\allowbreak pruefer\_compensation\_probe.py}):
source-only Pr\"ufer phases of the two arm chains (structural AST
firewall), exactly $16$ fixed phase cells (boundaries $k\pi/8$,
entrywise pairing primary, danger families predeclared),

\emph{before} any deployed-data run, deep holdouts kz

so in plain words rather than hiding it in a constant.

\subsection{The flow corridor: the determinant chain to the tau

Rounds 40/41 (2026-08-09) take the coordinates of rounds 38/39

\emph{The determinant chain: the wall as a tau-function sign
(\veri{v883\_tau\_chain\_parametrix.py}, $5/5 + 3/3 + 3/3$;

(fluctuations-required)}, \textsc{zones-measured
(both-required)}).}  The Schur determinant identities
\[
\sigma_h \;=\; \frac{\det(I - E)}{\det(B)}, \qquad
\det(I - E) \;=\; \det(I - R)\,\det(I - D_P)
\]
are machine-exact ($4.8\times10^{-13}$ in log space) with

$\operatorname{sign}\tau_h = \operatorname{sign}\sigma_h =$ the
sign of the wall with $\tau_h := \det(I - D_P)$ --- the scalar
wall of \texttt{PRIME.PORT.SCALAR.01} is the sign of a candidate
tau function; the Jacobi variational identity
$\tfrac{d}{ds}\log\det(I - sD_P) = -\operatorname{tr}[(I -
sD_P)^{-1}D_P]$ holds on the true family ($10^{-6}$); and the
determinant wall indicator is \emph{false} on both indefinite
controls.  The $\kappa/\rho$ readout is recorded:
$\operatorname{slope}(\log\sigma) = -2.93$ vs $2\times$ the
Mellin fluctuation slope $-2.53$ --- $\sigma \sim$
fluctuation$^{2}$ within $16\%$, the measured seed of the
leading-sign contract below.  The symbolic half --- $\tau_h$ as

Riemann--Hilbert problem of the \texttt{v881} generators, for

Four worlds through the identical pencil pipeline on every heavy
rung: the true comb holds the floor ($\tau = +1.7\times10^{-4}$

crashes harder ($-78$ to $-5537$); the plain continuum sits at

($u > U - 1$, ${\sim}40$--$44\%$ of the mass) breaks the floor
at $\tau = -3.7$ to $-22.1$; interior-only breaks it harder

every smoothing-based parametrix is dead, and the small

\subsection{The finite wall closure and the transfer
law}\label{sec:finite-closure}

Rounds 64--68 (2026-08-11) finish the \emph{finite} surface of
the wall end-form and then price it.  Two promoted modules
(suite $901\to904$ together with the seam companion of the
research-contracts lane) carry the result:
\veri{v909\_finite\_wall\_closure.py} (the composed closure)
and \veri{v910\_finite\_zero\_transfer.py} (the transfer law).

\emph{The finite wall closure
(\veri{v909\_finite\_wall\_closure.py},
\texttt{PRIME.WALL.FINITE\_CLOSURE.01}; $28/28$).}  On the
deployed finite ladder every reachable wall face is certified
from cited inputs, and the composed census
\[
  B \;\wedge\; \mathrm{W1} \;\wedge\; \mathrm{W2}
\]
holds on $39/39$ matched surface $+$ $8/8$ deep rungs (frozen
experiments runs of rounds 64--67, cited with their spec
hashes).  The three faces: the \emph{$B$-half} is the certified
chain of the previous subsection ($\min c_B = 0.5523$ over the
ideal source objects, $39/39$ surface $+$ $27/27$ deep steps at
declared float level).  The \emph{W1 face} is new twice over:
the two composition gaps that rounds 55--59 priced at $+8$ to
$+9$ dex (``concentration'' and the ``diagonal law'') dissolve
into \emph{one exact measure inequality} --- measure
monotonicity of the Christoffel--Darboux dual form (Loewner
step, composition price $+0.29$ dex, $v$-monotone so a floor
substitutes losslessly) --- and the remaining per-fold supply at
the named $j = 16$ seat is paid by \emph{verified zeros as exact
data}: the truncated explicit formula with $7{,}000$
mpmath-computed ordinates, every read tested against the
independent prime side and the tail bracketed by the
unconditional Rosser--Abel envelope, closes the $v$-floor on
$39/39$ surface rungs, composed $67/67$ with the cited deep
$28/28$.  The \emph{W2 face} is the recomposed certificate
$m_{\mathrm{cert}} = FC + \widehat{P}_{\mathrm{arith}} -
\mathrm{TAILB} > 0$ along the measured critical direction:
$16/67$ at the $7{,}000$-ordinate cache, $67/67 + 8/8$ once the
$20{,}000{,}000$-ordinate certified cache pays the priced tail
(Odlyzko tables $+$ LMFDB/Platt, every ordinate below the
Platt--Trudgian height $T_0 = 3\cdot10^{12}$ and hence on the
line unconditionally --- \textsc{external-cited}).  The
language discipline is frozen and non-negotiable: W1 and W2 are
\emph{algorithmically independent evaluations of the same
localized Weil form} --- a strong mutual crosscheck, \emph{not}
two independent proofs; every certified statement is per-rung,
on a finite family of Galerkin sections \emph{along the measured
critical direction} (direction-conditional; nothing is uniform
in $h$ or in direction); the deep block is float-level.  The
promoted module re-verifies the load-bearing spine
self-contained on a reduced frozen subset (its own committed
$7{,}000$-ordinate cache re-warded in-run: Rosser corridor per
index on both sides, $\gamma_1$ identity, independent
$|\zeta(\tfrac12 + i\gamma)|$ spot checks; heart ward on every
read with slack $+2.1$..$+4.8$ dex; closure $6/6$; the
off-line-impostor control fires at $8.2\cdot10^{4}\times$ the
genuine residual) and cites the full census rather than
recomputing it.  The promoted gate pins only that reduced
subset (meta-audit CCCXXXVI): a false cited full census would
not fail the module --- the $39/39 + 8/8$ census rests on the
frozen experiments runs and their spec hashes, not on the
\texttt{v909} gate.

\emph{The transfer law
(\veri{v910\_finite\_zero\_transfer.py},
\texttt{PRIME.WALL.FINITE\_ZERO\_TRANSFER.01}; $10/10$).}  With
the closure in hand the economics become measurable: per rung,
what zero-cutoff height $T_{\mathrm{req}}(h)$ does the
certificate actually consume?  The frozen full-ladder answer
(75 rungs, 42 declared prefix anchors, heart ward on all
$582\times42$ cells): $\log_{10} T_{\mathrm{req}} = -3.045 +
1.228\,\ln h$ ($R^2 = 0.882$), i.e.\
$T_{\mathrm{req}} \sim h^{2.8}$, and the ratio
$T_{\mathrm{req}}/(\pi/D_h)$ against the window's own spectral
reach \emph{grows} at $+0.897$ dex$/\ln h$ --- the verdict is
\textsc{ratio-growing}: the zero supply is an \emph{external
battery} (\textsc{w-unbounded-per-rung}), not a local sampling
law, and a bootstrap even less.  The census compresses into one
parametrized statement, the \emph{transfer law}:
$\mathrm{ZerosCertified}(T) \wedge \mathrm{TailEnvelope}(T)
\Rightarrow M_h \succ 0$ for \emph{all} deployed
$h \le H(T)$, with the measured monotone envelope
$H(\gamma_{7000}) = 254$, $H(\gamma_{2\mathrm{M}}) = 1256$,
$H(\gamma_{2\cdot10^{7}}) = 2806$.  The W1 face is cheap
($T_{\mathrm{req}} \le 5350$, binding on only $3/75$ rungs) ---
the wall curve is W2-priced almost everywhere --- and the next
$h$-decade would cost $T \sim 3.4\cdot10^{9}$
(${\sim}10^{10}$ ordinates): the finite engine does \emph{not}
scale by buying zeros, and $H(T)$ is the measuring rod any
future analytic per-window bound has to beat (a bound with
${\sim}\pi/D$ reach per window beats the measured $h^{2}$
battery by construction).  The promoted module re-verifies the
shallow end ($12$ rungs, $h$ 142..254, anchors $K =
250$..$7000$: closure census $2/3/4/6/8/12$, zero non-monotone,
$H$-consistency $12/12$ against the cited boundary $254$); its
gate pins only that shallow subset (meta-audit CCCXXXVI) ---
$H(\gamma_{2\mathrm{M}}/\gamma_{2\cdot10^{7}})$ and the
full-ladder fits are cited, not pinned by the \texttt{v910}
gate.

\emph{The open fronts after rounds 64--68.}  The finite surface
is closed and priced; what remains open is exactly the all-$h$
mountain: the $h$-uniformity of every chain beyond the deployed
ladder, the all-$h$/all-direction Weil-positivity object (the
\textsc{unif-path} caveat: positivity is certified on a finite
family of Galerkin sections along the measured critical
direction, never uniformly), the algebraic origin of the
registered $\tfrac12$, and --- the transfer law's own message
--- an analytic per-window bound in the ${\sim}\pi/D$ reach

verified-zero sum can never prove RH; the closure consumes
published zero verifications as citations (Odlyzko, LMFDB/Platt,
