\subsection{The form-convergence theorem: the extraction
chain's convergence premise stops being a
measurement}\label{sec:form-convergence-theorem}

Round CCCLXV (2026-08-13) closes the analytic edge that the
extraction chain of \S\ref{sec:invariance-atlas} had been
carrying as a \emph{measurement}
(\veri{v912\_form\_convergence\_theorem.py}, $35/35$, verdict
\textsc{formconv-proven}).  Besides the cofinal positivity
hypothesis, the chain --- and its Lean statement
\texttt{CofinalWeil.cofinal\_weil} --- consumes exactly one
analytic input: per-element convergence of the finite Galerkin
forms to the limit functional.  Until now that input was typed
from the corpus rates $-1.58$..$-1.84$ per level of
\veri{v848\_extraction\_chain.py}.  It is now a theorem, and an
unconditional one.

\emph{The statement.}  For $f$ real, supported in the deployed
window and \emph{affine on every grid cell}, with $K = f * \tilde
f$, $G = f' * \tilde f'$, $b_K = \operatorname{diam}\operatorname{supp}K$,
$B = b_K + D$, $\kappa_2 = \|f'\|_2^2 = G(0)$,
$\kappa_3 = \operatorname{Lip}(G)$ and $\kappa_K$ the supremum of
$|K''|$ over cell interiors,
\[
  |Q_D(f) - Q_W(f)| \;\le\;
  D^2\Bigl[(8\sinh(B/2) + \mathfrak{m}(B))A_2 + \Theta_0 A_0
  + (A_0 + A_2)\bigl(\log\tfrac1D + \log B + 4\bigr)
\]
\[
  \qquad\qquad
  + 2A_0 e^{-B/2}\bigl(\tfrac1B + 2\bigr) + A_1(1 + D)\Bigr]
  + (1 + D)\tfrac{D^3}{12}\kappa_3 ,
\]
with $A_0 = \kappa_2/12$, $A_2 = \kappa_K/8 + \kappa_2/12$,
$A_1 = \kappa_K$ and
$\Theta_0 = 3\log 2 + \pi/2 + \gamma + \log\pi =
5.372183419225665\ldots$ --- that is, rate
$O(D^2\log(1/D)) = O(2^{-2j}j)$.  For continuous $f$ one has
$\kappa_K = \kappa_2$ exactly and the log coefficient collapses
to $7/24$ (supremum $5/24$).

\emph{Why it is exact.}  Three steps carry the proof, and the
middle one is the load-bearing exactness.  First, the deployed
lag vector \emph{is} the capped Weil functional on the even
tent, $c_d = W_C[S_{dD,D}]$, so the finite form equals
$W_C[\widetilde K_D]$ on the even piecewise-linear interpolant
of $k_d = D a_d$ --- an identity, not an approximation.  Second,
the exact defect lemma: $k_d - K(dD) = -(D^2/12)\,G(dD)$ for
\emph{every} deployed lag, because $u \mapsto f(u)f(u + dD)$ is
a quadratic on each grid cell, the midpoint-rule error of a
quadratic is exactly $-(D^3/24)q''$, and $\Pi_D G = G$ since $G$
is piecewise linear with grid-node breakpoints; the gates verify
this with \emph{zero} deviation in exact rationals over $1474$
lag identities and $780$ strictly interior points.  Third, the
faithful cap $C \ge b_K + D$ makes the capped and uncapped
combs agree on the defect, so the whole error is $W_C$ applied
to \emph{one} explicit function, bounded layer by layer with
elementary majorants.

Two typed corrections belong to the statement.  The
interpolation constant is the interior supremum of $|K''|$, not
$\|f'\|_2^2$: the two agree exactly for continuous $f$, and
differ in both directions for jump elements (the frozen
elements E09 with $3 > 2$ and E10 with $5/3 < 2$).  And the law
is genuine rather than a loose envelope: measured against a
closed-form leading term --- no fit enters any gate --- the
ratio of true error to $|e_D(0)|\log(1/D)$ lies in
$[0.575, 1.066]$ and drifts to $1$ through $j = 18$.
Uniformity (V) holds on every class with a \emph{two-sided}
support window $b_- \le b_K \le b_+$, $b_- > 0$, and bounded
$(\kappa_K, \kappa_2, \kappa_3)$; it fails on an $L^2$ ball,
since $\kappa_2$ is an $H^1$ seminorm.

\emph{The correction the theorem forced.}  The chain as
originally written cited $C^0$-continuity of $Q_W$ at fixed
support for the passage from the dense family to the admissible
class.  In the pure sup norm that citation is \emph{false}, and
the must-fire control C5 says so explicitly: the even Lipschitz
family
$e_n(w) = \tfrac1n \min(1, w e^{n^2})(1 - w/2)_+$
has $e_n(0) = 0$ and $\|e_n\|_\infty = 1/n \to 0$ while
$|A[e_n]| = 2.57, 4.28, 6.19, 8.14, 10.11, 12.09$ grows linearly
in $n$ --- the same archimedean divergence already measured in
\S\ref{sec:invariance-atlas}'s companion round, where neither an
$L^2$ nor a sup-norm continuity constant was found.  The correct
hypothesis is uniform convergence \emph{plus} an equi-Lipschitz
(Dini) condition at the origin, which the admissible even
compactly supported BV class supplies automatically
($K = f * \tilde f$ with $f$ of bounded variation is Lipschitz).
The module verifies the corrected modulus of $W_C$ on a declared
twelve-perturbation battery.  This is a correction of a wrong
cited statement, not a downgrade of a result: the edge is
narrowed, and what stays cited is the density leg --- density of
the dyadic cellwise-affine family in the admissible class, in
\emph{that} topology.

\emph{What is cited and what is pinned.}  Eleven classical
inputs are typed, and none of them is a zero-free region, the
prime number theorem, a zeta zero or a fit.  The only cited
arithmetic input is Rosser--Schoenfeld's
$\psi(x) < 1.03883\,x$, consumed \emph{only} for the
support-uniform constant and never for convergence at fixed
$f$; it is independently sieve-verified in-run to $10^7$ (worst
ratio $1.038821$), while the all-$x$ statement remains the
citation.  Also cited and \emph{not} pinned by these gates: the
W1 measure dictionary, Weil's explicit formula and criterion
with the admissible class, and the universal quantifier itself
--- the gates run ten frozen elements and a twelve-member
translate family at $j = 4..11$ exactly or through the deployed
pipeline and at $j = 12, 14, 16$ through the stable defect
route, so the statement for \emph{all} admissible $f$ and all
levels is the paper proof plus the frozen probe specification.
On the Lean side the new module
\texttt{TfptCarrier/CofinalEnvelope.lean} states the envelope as
a named premise, derives the convergence hypothesis from it, and
restates the cofinal extraction theorems with that hypothesis
replaced by the instantiated envelope (kernel-checked, no
\texttt{sorry}); the envelope itself is not discharged inside
the kernel, so the formalisation gap is reduced rather than
closed.  The window conditions (H-grid), (H-cap) and (H-align)
hold for fixed $f$ and all large $j$, which is exactly what the
\texttt{atTop} limit needs.

Registered \texttt{PRIME.FORM.CONVERGENCE.THEOREM.01}.  The
chain's open item is unchanged: the predefined cofinal
positivity inequality --- cofinal in the same mesh-refinement
order $D_j = 2^{-j}$ in which this envelope holds --- untouched
and of RH strength.  Closing
this edge does not prove anything about the Riemann Hypothesis.
No marker moves.  \textbf{No statement about the Riemann
Hypothesis is made.}

\subsection{The remaining obstruction is signed and
alignment-carrying
(localization)}\label{sec:signed-alignment-localization}

Round CCCLXXIII (2026-08-13) does not close anything.  It
\emph{types} what is left, and the exact, cheap and
self-contained core of that typing is now a no-go module
(\veri{v913\_signed\_alignment\_localization.py}, $24/24$,
verdict \textsc{nogo-core-verified}).  The statement:

\begin{quote}
For the deployed budget shape the missing inequality is not a
magnitude statement.  The conversion constant of any hypothesis
of the form $|\psi(x) - x| \le f(x)\sqrt{x}$ is bounded below by
$\|K_D'\|_1 = 4$ uniformly in $D$, while the geometric supply
stays $O(1)$; Littlewood's unconditional $\Omega$-theorem
therefore makes the entire magnitude class empty, with floor
$4\log\log\log N_h$ against a slack that shrinks with depth.
The residual requirement is instead odd under the comb sign flip
and invariant under every congruence of the matrix stage, so no
reformulation, window choice or preconditioner can convert it;
the signed part is exactly the Weil prime term of an explicit
even test function, and the remaining statement is a zero-sum
inequality against a negative bar.  Its unsigned companion is
bounded unconditionally but its class floor, attained at an
admissible datum, still exceeds the need.  Consequently any
future input must be signed and must carry alignment
information; neither a magnitude bound nor a world-blind
grammatical identity can supply it.
\end{quote}

\emph{What the module pins.}  The six kernel identities are
exact in $D$ --- $\int K_D = 0$, $\|K_D\|_\infty = 1$,
$\|K_D\|_1 = 4D/3$, $D^{-1}\int K_D^2 = 2/3$,
$\int K_D e^{-t/2} = -(D/8)T_D^2$ and the load-bearing
$\|K_D'\|_1 = 4$ \emph{independent of $D$}: the conversion
constant of a magnitude hypothesis does not get cheap as the
mesh refines.  Against it the geometric supply, recomputed by
two independent routes agreeing to $1.6\times10^{-50}$, is
negative and $O(1)$ ($-1.2648057425013541016$ at $h = 184$,
$-1.3147508968858830811$ at $h = 388$), while the Littlewood
floor is $2.1654551$ at $N_h = 263$ and $4.1231791$ at
$N_h = 14\,634\,429$ --- a factor $214.7$ above the module's own
conservative slack and $1527.1$ above the deployed one.  The
three-term split $s = (n_0 - q_0) - n_c + 2\langle b_c, x_0
\rangle - q_c$ is an exact identity whose terms are invariant
under \emph{every} congruence $T = \operatorname{diag}(1, M)$,
with the outer terms even and the carrying term odd under
$b_c \mapsto -b_c$, and the $F_4$ kernel $A_2^{\mathsf T}B^{-1}A_2$
is itself a congruence invariant: an unsigned hull is
flip-invariant and therefore structurally unable to bound the
carrier below.  Selberg's symmetry formula is provably neutral
($\Lambda = \mu * \log$ and
$\mu * \log^2 = \Lambda\!\cdot\!\log + \Lambda * \Lambda$ are
formal identities in the free module on $\{\log p\}$;
information gain exactly $1.000$).  And the
Beurling--Nyman/Baez-Duarte target is empty in exact arithmetic:
$\lambda_{\min}(G_N) \le (\log 2\pi - \gamma)/N$ gives cap
$0.420220$ against the needed $c_B = 0.5523$, so no $N$-uniform
Gram floor exists and the deployed hypothesis is false for
$N \ge 3$, while the explicit family
$\widetilde G = AA^{\mathsf T} + (4/5)^2 I$ satisfies every
hypothesis of the certificate class at every $N$ with
$\widetilde d^{\,2} \ge 1/2$ forever --- the class is
non-implying.

\emph{Ten classes are empty, five are merely unexplored.}  For
this budget shape the following are proven empty: E1 every
magnitude hypothesis $|\psi(x) - x| \le f(x)\sqrt x$; E2 every
zero-density input with $A > 2$ ($A = 2$ and Lindel\"of land
exactly critical, with zero slack); E3 Selberg's symmetry
formula; E4 every congruence reformulation, window choice,
Jacobi/Cholesky preconditioner and resolvent split; E5 every
unsigned hull of the comb correction; E6 every bound consuming
only $\{w \ge 0, \|w\|_\infty, \|w\|_2, \operatorname{supp}w\}$;
E7 exact multiplicative transforms (M\"obius/Dirichlet); E8
natural-grammar identities (de Branges/HB, Abel); E9 the
Beurling--Nyman transport target; E10 thin/cofinal Li criteria,
by explicit counterexample.  \emph{No} emptiness is claimed for
U1 unconditional statements about ordinate positions, U2
alignment statements, U3 a different budget shape, U4 the four
premises of the reverse implication, or U5 global constraints on
the source profile.

\emph{What it does not say, named.}  (O1) Nothing is said
against arguments that legitimately consume zero positions ---
the remaining statement \emph{is} of that kind, which is not the
same as being false.  (O2) Only bounds inside the cone class are
forbidden; alignment statements are untouched and are exactly
what is needed.  (O3) Every clause is proven for the deployed
kernel, the deployed frame family and the predeclared rung
family; another budget shape lies outside.  (O4) The reverse
implication (inequality $\Rightarrow$ RH) rests on four named
premises and is \emph{not} established; the theorem prices only
the missing input of the forward direction.  (O5) Any new global
inequality restricting the admissible source profiles beyond
$\{w \ge 0, \text{size}, \text{support}\}$ changes the cone class
and escapes the argument.  The theorem is moreover
\emph{finite-rung} --- verified at $h = 184/388/839$ with the
ladder to $h = 12632$ --- it makes no all-$h$ claim and says
nothing about rungs outside the built cells.  It does
\emph{not} say that the Riemann Hypothesis is unprovable, that
the wall route fails, or that no proof exists.

\emph{The counter-evidence, carried and not smoothed.}  The
\textsc{no-witness} finding stands: the certified reads are
positive at all nine depths, with zero negatives and zero
straddles, and the deepest certified read is
$2.79579794131272506\times10^{-15}$ at $h = 12632$; this module
adds none.  On the $n_0$-normalised reading the decay
\emph{flattens} with depth --- upper-bound exponents $-3.21092511$
globally against $-2.67942161$ on the deepest step
$5746 \to 12632$ --- and the re-derived $s/D^2$ step
$1393 \to 2015$ is \emph{positive} ($+0.50302892$), so the
normalised drift is not monotone, and no re-derivable exponent
comes near the frozen collapse bar $-8.0$.  A no-go about the
\emph{type} of the missing input is not evidence about its
\emph{existence}.

Registered \texttt{PRIME.NOGO.SIGNED.ONLY.01} as an $[O]$
no-go/typing row.  It supplies no positivity, no new interval
and no new certificate; it closes no gate, narrows no gate and
moves no marker, and it must not be counted as evidence for or
against the Riemann Hypothesis nor cited in support of any
positivity claim.  The deployed matrix-stage reads that carry
the same conclusion under a float64 entry-slack premise and the
cited ladder stay in \texttt{experiments/} until that premise is
discharged.  \textbf{No statement about the Riemann Hypothesis
is made.}

\subsection{The kill atlas, the complete candidate map, and the
Obstruction Completeness Theorem (sandbox
probes)}\label{sec:kill-atlas-oct}

Four discovery freeze rounds of 2026-08-14 (notes CCCLXXVI and
CCCLXXVIII--CCCLXXX, with the surface-audit note CCCLXXVII in
between) consolidate the whole campaign into one falsifiable
object and one named endpoint.  Everything in this subsection is
\emph{sandbox}: four frozen probes in the experiments tree, no
module, no ledger row, no marker moved, no gate closed or
narrowed, and no claim about the Riemann Hypothesis in any
direction.  The suite stood at 906 modules at the freeze,
\texttt{v913} then the newest promoted module (954 today, after
the \texttt{v914}--\texttt{v961} promotions of
Sections~\ref{sec:roadmap}--\ref{sec:frontier-audits},
\ref{sec:epstein-detection-arc}, \ref{sec:prime-theorem-arc},
\ref{sec:spectral-edge-arc}, \ref{sec:endgame-arc},
\ref{sec:triple-cofinal-arc}, \ref{sec:postbughunt-arc},
\ref{sec:mechanism-arc} and \ref{sec:surface-orientation-arc}).

\emph{The map as one machine-refutable object (round 79,
\texttt{kill\_atlas\_dag\_probe.py}, $43/43$ gates, verdict
\textsc{atlas-dag-consistent} $+$
\textsc{one-open-edge-confirmed} $+$
\textsc{four-classical-citations-carried} $+$
\textsc{no-sign-source-passes} $+$
\textsc{localization-did-not-move-the-edge}).}  The RH
implication chain is reconstructed explicitly as an 11-node,
10-edge DAG (acyclic under Kahn on the conjunctive hypergraph),
typed 3 \textsc{proven} / 2 \textsc{certified-finite} / 4
\textsc{cited-classical} / 1 \textsc{open}, with exactly one
open edge E4 --- positivity at every rung of one
sign-independently predeclared family, cofinal in the
mesh-refinement order.  The honest non-\textsc{proven} list, in
topological order, is E1/E2/E8/E4/E7/E9/E10: two
certified-finite heads, the one open inequality, and four
classical citations (the Suzuki/W1 identification, density plus
the equi-Lipschitz/Dini continuity modulus, the faithful cap,
Weil's criterion) --- the qualifier of
Section~\ref{sec:signed-alignment-localization} carried as an
executable gate.  The 50-route kill atlas assigns every killed
route of the campaign to exactly one edge (17 on E4, 21 on the
finite scalar edge E2, 8 on E10, 2 on E1, 2 off-chain
seam/compiler results), every verdict token grep-verified
inside its own cited artifact; the $\tau$-screen reads 15
\textsc{disguise} / 1 \textsc{advance} / 34 not-applicable,
and the single \textsc{advance} (the per-step B-floor) does
\emph{not} land on E4.  Six coordinate systems --- $\tau_h > 0$,
$n_h - q_h > 0$, $\sigma_h < 1$, the anti-cancellation scalar,
the $P_{\mathrm{err}}$ budget, and \texttt{v913}'s
best-conditioned (L) --- are pinned as one and the same edge:
the twenty notes of localization work sharpened the edge's type,
closed the second open edge (\texttt{v912}) and corrected its
statement (mesh order), but did not move it.

\emph{The SAT adjudication (round 80,
\texttt{sat\_projection\_alignment\_probe.py}, $35/35$ gates,
verdict \textsc{sat-disguise} $+$
\textsc{sat-littlewood-emptied} $+$
\textsc{selection-sign-mined}).}  An externally proposed
``signed projection alignment'' closure of E4 is adjudicated
dead as submitted.  Its projection identity is exact ---
verified with zero residual in exact \texttt{Fraction}
arithmetic --- and empty: the column block of $A_2$ is
unit-triangular with determinant $1$ as exact integers, so
$P = I$ and the alignment-looking term $\|(I-P)y\|^2$ vanishes
identically; the ellipse inequality is $s \ge 0$ verbatim, and
the ``optimal signed profile'' $w^*$ is $B$-independent, purely
archimedean-combinatorial, carrying zero arithmetic.  The
$\theta$-average is verbatim the already-priced mean route
(\textsc{hh-claims-withdrawn}, \textsc{classical-gap}); the
proposed $\theta$-selection rule is exactly the
\texttt{signMinedIndex} shape whose non-noninterference is
kernel-checked in Lean; and the small-effective-rank premise is
refuted by measurement (stable rank grows $109.6 \to 1595.2$
from $h = 184$ to $2854$).  SAT is coordinate system number
seven for E4, not an attack on it; as the atlas's nineteenth
candidate sign source it fails the frozen gate (separates
without independently orienting --- its readout \emph{is} the
wall scalar).

\emph{The untested five adjudicated (round 81,
\texttt{untested\_sign\_sources\_probe.py}, $33/33$ gates,
verdict \textsc{signsources-adjudicated}).}  The five candidate
classes the atlas still carried as untested all fail with exact
killing numbers: the Euler-grouping/G2 weight law separates all
control worlds but its defect energy is zero on truth and its
class floor cannot force the deployed inequality
(\textsc{g2-separates-not-orients}); every source-side Krein
contractor certificate has margin exactly $1 - \|C\|^2 = s/n$,
the wall sign renamed (\textsc{krein-cert-is-wall}); the named
unconditional ordinate-position types are empty --- the honest
instrument on the full $2\times10^7$ certified ordinate cache
prices the required ordinate precision at $\sim\!1\%$ of the
mean zero spacing, Weyl equidistribution carries no rate,
rate-carrying density is the emptied E2 class, pair correlation
is conditional (\textsc{u1-named-types-empty}); the minimal
alignment statement MIN-U2 is named exactly and is
beyond-classical --- restricted to the deployed windows it
already excludes off-line zeros at $\delta = 0.209\ldots0.364$,
below the classical zero-free widths $\approx 0.444$ at those
heights (\textsc{u2-beyond-classical}); and every enumerated
global source-profile inequality dies on the downward-closure
lemma: the zero comb is admissible in every enumerated class, so
no upper-bound-type inequality can supply the required lower
bound (\textsc{u5-enumerated-dead}).  The candidate map is
thereby complete over the corpus vocabulary: \textbf{24
candidate sign sources, 0 \textsc{pass}, 19 \textsc{fail}, no
blanket-untested class left.}  (The round-108 audit,
Section~\ref{sec:frontier-audits}, makes the vocabulary fence
concrete: five classes outside the corpus vocabulary are named
and \emph{unpriced} --- ergodic/measure-rigidity positivity
transfer, model-theoretic/o-minimal counting, bigger-group
representation-theoretic positivity, GMC/Fyodorov--Hiary--Keating
with an enumeration gap, and higher-order Fourier uniformity of
M\"obius.)

\emph{The bird's-eye round and the endpoint (round 82,
\texttt{birdseye\_shape\_freedom\_probe.py}, $35/35$ gates,
verdict \textsc{birdseye-oct-consolidated}).}  The three degrees
of freedom every route had held fixed are adjudicated.  (a)
\textsc{shape-independence-measured}: the deployed family is
RH-saturating with measured margin-decay exponent $-3.379$;
five structurally different admissible alternative families
(Fej\'er, Gauss-tent, Hann, the $K\!\star\!K$ convolution
square, a T5.2-style perturbation --- all literally in the
\texttt{v912}/\texttt{v848} class), priced in the same
Weil-square currency with an exact explicit-formula ward, decay
far shallower (exponents $-0.46\ldots-1.09$, minimal gap
$2.29$) --- the maneuver exists but buys nothing: single-window
ladders fail the E7 density leg ($54.5\%$ projection residue of
an admissible target on the pooled span), any mesh-dense family
inherits $\lambda_{\min}(\Omega_{\mathrm{EF}}) \le s$ by an
exact Schur bound, and the localization is shape-invariant ---
square shapes degenerate the alignment (all $15/15$
position-blind ordinate worlds stay positive) and put the whole
unconditional content into off-line exclusion \emph{below} every
classical zero-free width ($\delta_{\min} = 0.055\ldots0.26$
against $\approx 0.42$, $5/5$ beyond-classical), while the
deployed linear coordinate reproduces the $\sim\!1\%$
sub-spacing bar.  The hardness is RH's, not the program's.  (b)
\textsc{existence-is-disguise}: the existence direction is
closed permanently at the border-membership step, in exact
\texttt{Fraction} arithmetic --- some positive extension always
exists (the softness is contentless), the arithmetic completion
being positive definite is equivalent to $s \ge 0$ both ways
($\det M = s \det B$), the Krein-admissible ellipsoid contains
the arithmetic border with margin exactly $s$, and the
Carath\'eodory--Toeplitz one-step interval is nonempty with the
true next autocorrelation admissible at margin equal to the next
Schur scalar: the residual gap between ``an extension exists''
and ``the arithmetic one is it'' \emph{is} E4.  (c)
\textsc{bootstrap-still-dead}: under the round-81 repricing the
$2\times10^7$-ordinate cache certifies MIN-U2 at $2/5$ built
cells and the $\tau$ coordinate at $0/5$; the growth law is
$T_{\mathrm{req}} \sim h^{4.77}$ on the $\tau$ coordinate, the
cache's extrapolated $\tau$-coverage ends at $h \approx 36$, and
precision is not binding --- height is.

\begin{quote}
\textbf{The Obstruction Completeness Theorem} (wall
architecture; finite-rung; machine-asserted premises; no RH
claim): (i) the implication DAG has exactly one open edge, E4;
(ii) the candidate map is complete over the corpus vocabulary
--- 24 candidate sign sources, 0 pass, 19 fail, no
blanket-untested class; (iii) the missing input is exactly
characterized --- signed, alignment-carrying, unconditional, an
ordinate-position statement at $\sim\!1\%$ of the mean zero
spacing, whose minimal form MIN-U2 is already beyond the
classical unconditional toolbox on the deployed windows; (iv)
the characterization is shape-independent across the audited
admissible families --- with the dual/existence direction closed
and the finite-input bootstrap dead.
\end{quote}

\emph{Scope, in the same breath.}  The theorem is finite-rung
(cells built to $h = 2854$, the certified ladder cited to
$12632$); atlas completeness is completeness over the routes
named in the campaign notes (an editorial claim, typed as such,
not a gate); E7--E10 remain classical citations; and the
counter-evidence travels unsmoothed --- \textsc{no-witness}
stands: all certified reads are positive to $h = 12632$ (deepest
$2.79579794131272506\times10^{-15}$), the normalised decay
flattens, and no collapse bar is approached.  The theorem turns
``why does RH not fall to this program?''\ into a
machine-checked statement with an exact domain of validity; it
says nothing about the truth, provability or falsity of RH and
is not evidence in either direction.  A no-go about the
\emph{type} of the missing input is not evidence about its
\emph{existence}.

\subsection{The real-root architecture, the Parity Lemma, and
the sign-position predictor (sandbox
probes)}\label{sec:realroot-signpos}

Six further discovery freeze rounds of 2026-08-14 (notes
CCCLXXXII--CCCLXXXVII) then attacked the one construction
direction the Obstruction Completeness Theorem of
Section~\ref{sec:kill-atlas-oct} leaves untyped --- building the
missing object rather than bounding it --- and ended with the
missing object in its most concrete form so far.  Everything in
this subsection is \emph{sandbox}: ten frozen probes in the
experiments tree, no module, no ledger row, no marker moved, no
gate closed or narrowed, and no claim about the Riemann
Hypothesis in any direction.  The suite stood at 906 modules at
the freeze (952 today).
One convention governs the numbers below: an adversarial bughunt
round (round 87) audited everything produced in rounds 79--85
and corrected three \textsc{major} misstatements in the
round-83/84 records; per the standing N12 convention the frozen
probes and notes are \emph{not} retro-edited --- the correction
is the record --- and this subsection carries only the corrected
values.

\emph{The real-root architecture (round 83, three lanes:
\texttt{semilocal\_realroot\_limit\_probe.py} $16/16$, verdict
\textsc{realroot-architecture-open};
\texttt{stc\_sol\_convergence\_probe.py} $4/4$, verdict
\textsc{stc-open}; \texttt{stc\_opus\_convergence\_probe.py}
$20/20$, verdict \textsc{stc-disguise} $+$ \textsc{stc-false}
for the mesh family).}  The first route of the campaign to
genuinely leave the kill atlas: instead of proving positivity of
the Weil form (edge E4), build finite \emph{self-adjoint}
source-only operators --- real spectra by construction, no wall
positivity, no zero data consumed --- and identify the limit
with $\Xi$ through the full trace formula on a determining even
Paley--Wiener class; compactness, Hurwitz, Hadamard and
determination then give RH.  Lane one audits the skeleton as
executable gates (Hurwitz sound; the determination lemma sound
in two classical steps with \emph{no convergence rate consumed};
two repairable gaps found and repaired, an origin-exclusion
minorant derivable from R3 itself and the source-only $E''(0)$
pin $\sum_\rho 1/(\rho(1-\rho)) = 2 + \gamma - \log 4\pi$), and
measures the Connes extremal family: census fully real ($41/41$
at $x = 13$), all six trace rows converge, world controls
separate at median $1.26\times10^6$--$1.40\times10^6$ against
the pre-frozen bar 5 --- at the honest price that the minimizer
direction exists only at internal precision $\sim e^{-4\pi x}$
($\lambda_{\min} = 2.5\times10^{-54}$ at $x = 13$).  The
corrected zero-tracking read (round 87, finding F1) is
\emph{stronger} than the one first recorded: the exact-mp census
puts the first-zero deviation at $-8.4\times10^{-16}$ at $x = 8$
\emph{and} $x = 13$ --- exactly the cache's own float64
quantization of $\gamma_1$ --- and the mean displacement over
all 15 matched zeros at $0.0$ in float64 resolution (the
minimizer zeros sit on the cached ordinates below the
comparator's own floor); the corrected $\varepsilon$ finals move
by up to $117\%$ under the exact census (round 87, finding F6)
with all six rows still \textsc{converges}.  Lane two builds the
Connes--van Suijlekom quotient source-only, hits
$14.1347/21.0220/25.0109$ at $x = 8$ with no zero read, and
proves the structural point: \textbf{R3 alone implies Weil
positivity} ($h = |\hat g|^2$ on a real spectrum), so the trace
convergence carries full RH strength.  Lane three proves the
\textbf{Nyquist density obstruction} for its mesh-CF family:
$\operatorname{spec} H_N$ has constant density $\ell/2\pi$
exactly and mesh-independently (rel.\ deviation
$2.22\times10^{-16}$ over a $16\times$ mesh sweep) while $\Xi$'s
zeros have density $\log(\tau/2\pi)/2\pi$ --- so R3 and R4 fail
for every mesh at fixed window; the unweighted trace diverges on
all four batteries to $x = 144$ while the weighted trace
converges (honest finals $9.3\times10^{-4}$ /
$3.3\times10^{-6}$ / $2.3\times10^{-6}$ / $6.2\times10^{-4}$;
round 87, finding F4), but the weights are the Christoffel
function of the zero measure --- the unknown; the honest
node-vs-zero pairing at $x = 55$ is 18-vs-3 one-sided (36-vs-6
two-sided; round 87, finding F2).  The three lanes ended in a
recorded conflict, deliberately frozen unresolved for an arbiter
round.

\emph{The arbiter (round 84,
\texttt{realroot\_arbiter\_probe.py}, $17/17$ gates,
independently re-run bit-identical, verdict
\textsc{realroot-depth-undecided}).}  The conflict is resolved
\emph{by mechanism}: different operator family, not different
sums, not a bug, not primarily depth.  All three lanes computed
honest unweighted sums against the identically normalized source
side.  The discriminator is the band census across depth, with a
new deep rung $x = 21$ built at the honest price ($K = 80$, 128
dps against the declared floor $4\pi x/\ln 10 + 5 = 119.6$,
$\lambda_{\min} = 1.25\times10^{-93}$): the mesh-CF family's
$(0,30)$ count grows $7 \to 22$ from $x = 5$ to $144$, tracking
the uniform Nyquist prediction (measured deviations
$10.2/10.6/10.9\%$ at $x = 13/21/34$ against the frozen $30\%$
tolerance; round 87, finding F3) --- lane three's density
theorem confirmed for its own family --- while the
extremal/quotient family stays \emph{exactly} on the $\Xi$
census at every measured depth: $(0,30) = 3$, $(0,60) = 13$,
$(0,100) = 29$ at $x = 21$, minimum zero $= \gamma_1$ to
$10^{-4}$, with all 50 Nyquist-excess zeros exiled to $(100,
163]$ where fixed test functions are blind.  On one unified
table (same $h$, same normalization, same unweighted sum) the
mesh family diverges on all four batteries while the extremal
family converges on the same four.  The verdict is
\textsc{realroot-depth-undecided} --- not false-for-family (the
obstruction reaches the extremal object in no measured band),
not quotient-escapes (the thinning is \emph{measured}, not
proven; Connes' section 6.6 remains open) --- and the new
\textbf{Z1-transfer identity} names why a proof is the wall
itself: the trig-Galerkin matrix \emph{is} the Gram matrix of
zero evaluations, $M[j,k] = 2\sum_\gamma
B_j(\gamma)B_k(\gamma)$ with $\lambda_{\min} = 2\sum_\gamma
E(\gamma)^2$ (deviation $6.31\times10^{-5}$ after the analytic
cache-tail correction, $92\%$ model share) --- the minimizer
minimizes its own transform \emph{on the true ordinates}:
source-only in input, zero-measure in content.  Since R3 alone
is RH-hard, no finite rung can verify the architecture ---
falsification rungs are priced ($x = 34$: $K = 150$ at $\ge 191$
dps, $\sim$1.5 h; $x = 55$: $K = 276$ at $\ge 305$ dps,
$\sim$10 h) --- and the surviving lemma carries full RH
strength.

\emph{The TPL round (round 85, three independent lanes on the
thinning-persistence lemma: \texttt{tp\_sol\_probe.py} $7/7$,
verdict \textsc{tpl-obstructed}; \texttt{tp\_opus\_probe.py}
$32/32$, verdict \textsc{tpl-reduced} $+$
\textsc{tpl-dichotomy-measured} $+$ \textsc{tpl-obstructed};
\texttt{tp\_da\_probe.py} $9/9$, verdict
\textsc{tpl-circular}).}  Lane Sol proves the off-line-quartet
obstruction: off the line the Z1 sum is an indefinite bilinear
form ($\Delta Q = -4\delta^2 E'(t)^2 < 0$ at simple real zeros)
yet Rouch\'e preserves the band count --- \textbf{energy sign
and zero census are locally independent observables} (measured:
$\lambda_{\min}$ flips to $-9.1\times10^{-17}$ at $1.25\,
\delta^*$ while the $(0,30)$ count stays 3 and roots move
$5.5\times10^{-9}$).  Lane Opus supplies the strongest
mathematics of the round: the ARCH block \emph{is} the smooth
zero measure exactly (rel.\ $1.1\times10^{-6}$), the
density-level ground state is negative and $O(1)$ on every rung
--- the entire $e^{-cx}$ positivity is supplied by the prime
block alone, so no density-input argument can prove TPL(i);
$\|\mathrm{PRIME}\|/\mathrm{gap} \sim 10^{4.36x}$, so any
prolate comparison must be an exact cancellation, never
perturbative; \textbf{the Parity Lemma}: the basis collapses to
one secular function, and TPL(i) \emph{is} --- no analysis, a
finite combinatorial rewriting --- the statement that the ground
eigenvector of one explicit matrix carries a prescribed sign
pattern, verified exactly on three rungs; and \textbf{the
counting law}: the Nyquist surplus peaks at $D_{\max} = x -
3/8$, the tracking band ends exactly at the peak, and the
marginal cost $d(-\log\lambda_{\min})/dD_{\max} =
10.1\ldots11.3$ is constant to $11\%$ over 23 decades --- the
$e^{-cx}$ law of the whole architecture is a counting law, each
forced skip (each sign change) costing one fixed factor
$e^{-11}$.  Lane Advocate convicts the route's measured support
as circular: the recorded band counts \emph{are} the smooth
Riemann--von Mangoldt values to $< 1$ ($29.0023$ against $29$);
the instrument transcribes whatever measure it is fed (the
prime-free smooth world gets its own clean census); outrunning
classical zero verification would need $x \sim 3.8\times10^{11}$,
i.e.\ dps $\sim 2.1\times10^{12}$; the only off-line-sensitive
channel is the wall scalar itself (measured slope $2.03$,
independently confirming Sol's $-4\delta^2E'^2$ law).  The three
lanes reconcile into one picture, and the round's one-sentence
status: the \emph{number} of ground-eigenvector sign changes is
forced by counting --- the arithmetic substance sits exclusively
in the \emph{positions} of the sign changes, which the prime
block alone must supply.

\emph{The simplicity round (round 86,
\texttt{simple\_principle\_probe.py}, $22/22$ gates, verdict
\textsc{simple-principle-is-transcription}).}  Four readings of
``the simple principle must thread through everything,'' each
with pre-registered consequences and frozen bars.  The one-axiom
reading is refuted in its strong form (five natural
normalizations, zero hits on the declared constant $\log\pi$,
gaps $0.226$--$1.341$; the difference-level dictionary is exact,
so the equality is exact as a gauge orbit and empty as a
source).  The transcription reading is \emph{confirmed} $3/3$ on
the sharpest claimed arithmetic outputs: the register's Mertens
head is exactly $\prod_{p \mid 210}(1 - 1/p) = 48/210$, i.e.\
$2.1293$ bit $= \log_2(35/8)$ --- the ``arithmetic output'' is
the compiler pair itself --- and the $E''(0)$ pin is the
Hadamard identity to $2.4\times10^{-8}$.  The fixed-point
reading is refuted (the compression transcribes every fed
measure: back-distance exactly $1.0000\,\delta$ under jitter).
The Gram-seat square law $\delta_* =
\sqrt{\mathrm{margin}/\mathrm{curvature}}$ is measured
numerically exact on the Gram channel (ratio $0.9997$, slope
$2.0000$) with the order split (position first-order, reality
second-order; on-line slope $0.9669$) --- and by the frozen
FOLDCOV rule it is typed \textsc{pattern-only-even-if-confirmed}.
What survives is one principle: \textbf{TFPT's positivity is
always Gram positivity of node evaluations --- a theorem exactly
where the nodes are compiler data --- and the arithmetic seam is
the single place whose nodes are not.}  Two measured corollaries
sharpen the OCT without moving it: the order split mechanically
explains why all 24 candidate sign sources died (they sought
first-order information in a channel that carries reality only
at second order), and the $\sim\!1\%$ sub-spacing price is
instrument-dependent --- $\sqrt{\mathrm{margin}/
\mathrm{curvature}}$, scaling like $h^{-1.69}$ along the
deployed ladder.  Tested simplicity adds nothing beyond the OCT;
it explains why the OCT looks the way it does.

\emph{The bughunt round (round 87,
\texttt{bughunt\_r79\_r85\_probe.py}, $24/24$ gates, verdict
\textsc{bughunt-findings}(9, max \textsc{major})).}  An
adversarial audit of everything produced in rounds 79--85: nine
findings, 3 \textsc{major} / 6 \textsc{minor} / 0 \textsc{fatal},
\emph{no round verdict flips}, every finding pinned by an
executable gate.  The three majors are the corrections carried
above (the first-zero/mean-displacement conflation, whose honest
resolution is stronger than the published claim; the 36-vs-3
pairing, honestly 18-vs-3; the float64-refinement artifact in
the published $\varepsilon$ finals, with gated survival of every
verdict).  One systemic minor: nine gates across the corpus are
hardcoded \texttt{check(..., True)} and can never fail while
counted in the $N/N$ tallies --- including the very line that
records the round-80 ``candidate \#19 gate FAIL'' verdict (the
verdict is right; the gate tests nothing).  Checked clean: every
round-79--82 headline number reproduces on fresh re-runs, all
ten probes re-ran green, no firewall violations.

\emph{The sign-position round (round 88,
\texttt{signpos\_probe.py}, $19/19$ gates, independently re-run
bit-identical, verdict \textsc{signpos-predictor-exact} $+$
\textsc{signpos-tp-dead} $+$ \textsc{signpos-rigid} $+$
\textsc{signpos-k-stable}).}  The campaign's most concrete
endpoint: the positions of the ground-eigenvector sign changes
--- the single open object left by the Parity Lemma --- attacked
with the oscillation/total-positivity/node-duality toolbox.  A
\textbf{source-only predictor of the sign-change positions
exists and is exact}: the parity of $\operatorname{round}(
\theta(\omega_k)/\pi + 1 + S_x(\omega_k))$ at the Nyquist
lattice, where $S_x$ is the band-limited phase built from the
prime-node comb, is exact at \emph{all 79 lattice points} across
$x = 3/5/8/13$, with measured first-order arithmetic content:
the density alone fails at exactly four lattice points and the
prime-node comb repairs precisely those four (arithmetic load
4) --- the first arithmetically computable first-order-channel
object of the campaign; a scramble control fails $6/11$ with
$\lambda_{\min} = -1.11$, so the exactness is
explicit-formula-specific, not a pipeline transcription.  The
catch is named precisely: proving the predictor's exactness for
\emph{all} $x$ is half-integer-margin control of the
band-limited $S$ at the lattice points (measured minimum margin
shrinking to $0.0317$), which is verbatim TPL(i) itself --- the
RH hardness relocates for the \emph{third} time to the same
seat, now as a rounding-margin statement about one explicit
band-limited function of the primes.  Gantmacher--Krein is
structurally dead (the density blocks are indefinite,
$\lambda_{\min}(\mathrm{ARCH}) = -2.666$; $M$ is neither totally
nonnegative nor a Green's/one-pair matrix in any tested
ordering; the minor census localizes nothing); the map
$\{$ordinate positions$\} \to \{$sign pattern$\}$ is
\emph{rigid} with modulus equal to the ordinate-to-lattice
distance (TPL(i) is exactly the statement that the prime block
never carries a node across the lattice); and the sign-change
positions are stable in $K$ inside the deployed band (the
round-85 well-posedness caveat is discharged for the positions;
the joint $(x,K)$ declaration remains for the margins).

\emph{Correction of record (round 97, 2026-08-15,
\texttt{sp\_expsum\_pricing\_probe.py}, $13/13$ gates, verdict
\textsc{sp-operative-falsified} --- carried per the round-87
convention: the frozen probes and notes are not retro-edited,
the correction is the record).}  The predictor's exactness holds
at $x \le 13$ only.  Round 97
(Section~\ref{sec:instrument-tier}) extended the census from the
79 lattice points ($x \le 13$) to $18798$ points ($x \le 890$,
the cache edge $\gamma_{7000} = 7264.75$) and measured the
\emph{operative} form of this predictor ---
$\operatorname{round}(N_{\mathrm{src}}(\omega_k)) =
N_{\mathrm{true}}(\omega_k)$, TPL(i)'s finite form ---
\textbf{false from $x = 21$ onward}, with $567$
$\tau$-screened counterexamples: the round-88 exactness was a
small-$x$ accident of the margin budget.  The mechanism is
arithmetic-free --- the Fej\'er taper's irreducible
tracking-variance floor ($\mathrm{rms} \to 1/(2\pi) = 0.159$,
measured $0.26$) against the $0.5$ budget, so no taper in this
family survives --- and the same round priced the budget as
classically out of reach (best unconditional miss $\times 8.2$;
even the RH-conditional bound reads $1.015$ at the deepest
rung), with the prefix/exceptional-set salvage measured dead
in-window.  The fence travels with the correction: what died is
the deployed \emph{source-side approximant}, not TPL(i) itself
--- the eigenvector truth side is unmeasured beyond $x = 13$ ---
and the round-88 claim as published (exact at all 79 points, $x
\le 13$) remains factually true; its operative extension is now
measured dead.

\begin{quote}
\textbf{Where the arc leaves the campaign} (sandbox; no RH
claim): the wall route is closed as a theorem (the OCT of
Section~\ref{sec:kill-atlas-oct}); the only architecture that
genuinely escapes the kill atlas is adjudicated
\textsc{realroot-depth-undecided} with its measured support
convicted circular; and the missing object now has its most
concrete form ever --- the eigenvector sign-change positions,
equivalently the rounding margins of one explicit band-limited
prime function --- and carries full RH strength in every
coordinate system in which it has been written.
\end{quote}

\emph{Scope, in the same breath.}  All of this is exploration:
finite measurements on reachable rungs ($x \le 21$ for the deep
census, $x \le 13$ for the predictor), no all-$x$ statement, no
positivity claim, no promotion, and per the bughunt's own
framing its $24/24$ \textsc{pass} means ``the audit is
consistent,'' not ``no bugs.''  RH is neither proven nor
disproven here; what is documented is the complete map of why,
now including the object-construction direction.  \textbf{No
statement about the Riemann Hypothesis is made.}

\subsection{The Stieltjes--Vitali pin route and the Krein
screw-function carrier (sandbox
probes)}\label{sec:svpin-krein}

Two further discovery freeze rounds of 2026-08-14 (notes
CCCLXXXIX--CCCXC) then attacked the resolvent direction the arc
of Section~\ref{sec:realroot-signpos} leaves open: replace the
full semilocal trace convergence by countably many positive
scalars, and build the one carrier the corpus did not have.
Everything in this subsection is \emph{sandbox}: two frozen
probes in the experiments tree, no module, no ledger row, no
marker moved, no gate closed or narrowed, and no claim about the
Riemann Hypothesis in any direction.  The suite stood at 906
modules at the freeze (952 today).

\emph{The Stieltjes--Vitali pin route (round 89, externally
proposed, contract \textsc{prime.stieltjes.vitali.pin.01};
\texttt{stieltjes\_vitali\_pin\_probe.py}, $17/17$ gates,
$249$\,s, independently re-run bit-identical, verdict
\textsc{svpin-route-open}).}  The proposal replaces the full
semilocal trace convergence by countably many positive resolvent
scalars in the absolutely convergent Euler half-plane: the pins
$P_x(\sigma) = \sum_k 2\sigma/(\lambda_{x,k}^2 + \sigma^2)$ must
converge to $\xi'/\xi(1/2 + \sigma)$ at the countable family
$\sigma_r = 1 + 1/r$, where the right side is source-only
($\Gamma$, $\pi$, $\Lambda(n)$, $n^{-s}$ --- absolutely
convergent for $s > 1$); then Herglotz normal-family compactness
(\emph{one} pin suffices), Vitali on the pins accumulating at
the interior point $i$, the identity theorem on $\Im z > 1/2$
(where $\Xi$ is zero-free), analytic continuation on the
connected $\mathbb{C}_+ \setminus Z(\Xi)$, and the pole
contradiction give $(\mathrm{SV}) \Rightarrow \mathrm{RH}$, with
the functional equation closing $\beta < 1/2$.  \textbf{The
skeleton is sound, gate by gate}: the weight-comparability
constant $C_D = 65.01$ (bar $2\times10^3$) is executed per rung
(normal-family ratio $0.033$ on all four); the sign-convention
ambiguity of earlier rounds is \emph{harmless} for the pins ---
$\Xi(z) = \xi(1/2 - iz)$ and $\xi(1/2 + iz)$ give the identical
target via $\xi'/\xi(1-s) = -\xi'/\xi(s)$, with a numeric lock
at $\sigma = 1$ (dev $2.3\times10^{-8}$); the spectrum honesty
is measured, not assumed (census $4/10/20/41$ all real, no zero
mode, min spacing $\ge 1.3$); the degenerate Herglotz limit is
excluded by the pin bound.  The \emph{one} named condition: the
all-$x$ realness of the spectra is the CF simplicity-plus-%
evenness hypothesis, so the skeleton is conditional on it.  The
named non-gap, stated as bluntly as the probe states it:
\textbf{the chain moves the entire burden into (SV) itself} ---
no skeleton step is the wall; the wall is the premise.  The tail
bookkeeping is computed explicitly and all three tails decrease
(true zero tail beyond the band $2.85\times10^{-2} \to
1.18\times10^{-2}$, within $2\%$ of the $\log T/T$ model;
measured Nyquist-excess edge mass $\le 1.31\times10^{-3}$, the
window definition corrected in the spec after a smoke caught
excess zeros spilling past the band edge; exact lattice tail
$1.35\times10^{-2} \to 8.0\times10^{-3}$).  The finite pre-check
\textbf{converges on all 16 frozen $\sigma$ values} ($x =
3/5/8/13$; $x = 21$ skipped and declared by the arbiter cost
law): $\Delta$ negative everywhere (the missing tail dominates),
slopes $-0.62\ldots-0.65$, measured drop $2.6$ against the
a-priori Riemann--von Mangoldt model $2.4$ (bar $1.6$), with
\emph{no} $\sigma\downarrow 1/2$ rate degradation on this ladder
(the expected boundary effect lies beyond reachable depth,
stated honestly), and the full divisor row converges
\emph{faster} (the lattice comb compensates $\sim\!2/3$ of the
missing tail).  All four world controls separate --- the mesh-CF
family is \textbf{mesh-poisoned through the same pins} (median
overshoot growing $0.94 \to 6.32$ like $\log x$: the wrong
limit, measured); \textsc{scrpos}/\textsc{epstein}/%
\textsc{smooth}/\textsc{scrarith} separate at medians
$2.7\times10^{5}$--$8.8\times10^{5}$ (band metric) and
$12.4$--$45.9$ (target metric) on $16/16$ rows (\textsc{scrarith}
throws one imaginary pair --- the world breaks the SV realness
hypothesis, reported); Christoffel weights are structurally
excluded by an AST gate; and the $\tau$-screen shows $0/16$
relocations at max slope $0.009$ over $\sim\!47$ decades ---
\textbf{no disguise}: the pins measurably live away from the
wall margin.  And the honest weight, Z1-typed as the actual
adjudication: on the extremal family the measured pin
convergence \emph{is} the transcription of cache partial sums
(band pins against cache rel $7.7\times10^{-12}$ /
$9.4\times10^{-12}$ / $2.1\times10^{-5}$) --- instrument
consistency, never source-side content --- and the naive Suzuki
spectral readout is \emph{dead} (\textsc{suzpin-form-spectrum}:
the hat-compression eigenvalues are a form-spectrum ladder
$\sqrt{\mu} = 1.02/2.12/3.17\ldots$, not the ordinates
($\gamma_1 = 14.13$); $P_{\mathrm{suz}}(1)$ grows $1.85 \to
2.47$ against the target $0.046$).  The route is the
\emph{second} architecture of the campaign to survive every
gate, and its reduction --- countably many safe scalars in place
of a test-class quantification --- is the corpus's logically
sharpest open target; its burden of proof is unchanged, only
sharper localized, and the priced remaining task is exactly one:
the Krein inverse-spectral realization of Suzuki's screw
function, which the corpus did not have.

\emph{The Krein screw-function carrier (round 90, contract
\textsc{prime.suzuki.krein.realization.01};
\texttt{krein\_screw\_realization\_probe.py}, $22/22$ gates,
$18$\,s, independently re-run bit-identical, verdict
\textsc{suzkrein-carrier-open}(lemma: uniform Weyl-disk
contraction)).}  The priced missing ingredient, built and
adjudicated.  The screw function $g$ is extracted corpus-exactly
(Suzuki's eq.~1.3 with the v643 convention lock; the Lerch
coefficient $+1/4$ is \emph{gated} against the origin expansion
$g \sim \tfrac12 t\log t + At$ with $A = \tfrac12(\log 2\pi -
\psi(2)) = 0.707546$ --- a $-1$ misreading would fail by
$O(1)$); the screw property is verified ($G(t,s) = g(t-s) - g(t)
- g(-s)$ PSD on all four windows,
$\lambda_{\min}/\lambda_{\max} \ge -8.1\times10^{-19}$); the
invoked theorem is named with its hypothesis \emph{certified}:
Krein's accelerant/continual-Schur correspondence (Krein 1955;
discrete transcription Verblunsky/Geronimus), whose hypothesis
--- strict positivity of every Toeplitz section of the
accelerant $-g''$ --- is certified by the completed Szeg\H{o}
run ($\max|\alpha| = 0.156$); and the normalization is
\emph{derived, not fitted} --- the lag reads are exact second
differences of $g$ (two independent routes agreeing to
$1.8\times10^{-10}$), a partition of unity gives the pin as
$\tfrac12\langle -g'', e^{-\sigma|\cdot|}\rangle$, and the Weil
formula identifies the target $\xi'/\xi(1/2+\sigma)$ layer by
layer (archimedean, pole and prime layers each gated).  The
inverse solve is classical: \textbf{the Levinson/Szeg\H{o}
recursion \emph{is} the Toeplitz-structured discrete
Krein/Gelfand--Levitan equation}; the Verblunsky coefficients
are the realized Hamiltonian data and are \emph{causal} (exact
Toeplitz nesting: deeper windows only append); and \textbf{the
realized Hamiltonian sees the primes} --- $|\alpha|$-spikes at
$r = \log q$ for $q = 2, 3, 4, 5, 7$, offset $\le 1$ bin,
contrast $2.8$--$5.2$.  The conditioning is trivial
(amplification $\sim\!23$ under $10^{-25}$ perturbations --- the
feared $e^{cx}$ explosion belongs to the trig-family
spectral-resolution ladder, not to the screw-kernel Toeplitz
sections), and the $\delta$-rough pointwise profile is declared
honestly: the $\delta$-stable objects (pins, disks, spike
positions) are what is gated.  The decisive measurement: with
the 16 frozen $\sigma$ values taken verbatim from the SVPIN
spec, \textbf{all 16 rows converge, 16/16 truth-tight} ($\sigma
= 0.6$: $\Delta = +7.30\times10^{-5} \to +6.33\times10^{-7}$
over $L = \log 3\ldots\log 13$), with the Weyl-disk contraction
\emph{measured} as $R \sim e^{-(\sigma + c)L}$, $c =
0.85\ldots1.76$, median $1.36$ (limit-point behaviour); and the
round's surprise: \textbf{the disk center resums the missing
tail} ($|\hat P - S_{\mathrm{trunc}}|$ against the tail model,
median ratio $1.000$; at $\sigma = 0.6$ the center beats the
truncated source sum by a factor $\sim\!600$) --- the residual
is the arithmetic fluctuation beyond the window.  The controls
die \emph{at the positivity level itself}, the strongest
separation of the campaign: the prime-free \textsc{smooth}
accelerant \textbf{loses screw positivity} at window depth $r =
0.264$ (the same $r$ at both mesh sizes --- a continuum
property, not a grid artifact), the golden-scrambled
\textsc{scrarith} world at $r = 0.744$: \textbf{the true primes
--- positions and weights --- are necessary for the screw
positivity of these windows.}  And the screen that every
previous pin carrier failed is passed for the first time:
\textbf{no Z1 cache transcription} (the minimum over all $N \le
7000$ of the max-$\sigma$ relative deviation is
$8.5\times10^{-3}$ against the bar $10^{-6}$; AST firewall
zero-free; \textsc{suzkrein-extrapolates}$(1.000)$) --- and the
carrier is explicitly distinct from the dead de Branges route
(\textsc{debranges-comb-blind}) in input (screw lag data, not
wall-block moments), direction (inverse-spectral construction,
not HB re-coordinatization) and adjudication (quantitative
convergence plus world controls, not structure existence); the
dead \textsc{suzpin} form-spectrum readout is never used.  The
repricing, from measurements: the literal SVPIN trace-class norm
is \emph{measured flat} ($16/16$ non-decaying; the appended
Verblunsky blocks grow --- prime atoms arrive forever), so the
correct currency is not trace-class but Weyl-disk contraction,
and the minimal missing lemma is stated exactly: \emph{let $g$
be Suzuki's screw function with every finite section of $-g''$
positive ($=$ localized Weil positivity); then the Weyl disks
$D_a(i\sigma)$ of the Krein realization of $-g''$ contract with
$R_a(\sigma) \le C(\varepsilon)\,e^{-(\sigma + c)\cdot 2a}$
uniformly on $\sigma \ge 1/2 + \varepsilon$, with limit point
$\xi'/\xi(1/2 + \sigma)$} --- suppliers: Krein's accelerant
theorem (existence and identification \emph{given} all-$a$
positivity) and de Branges chain monotonicity (nesting); open is
the uniformity as $\sigma \downarrow 1/2$ --- \textbf{and the
honest price, unchanged: the all-$a$ section-positivity
hypothesis \emph{is} localized Weil positivity itself.}  The
carrier localizes the remaining task (one disk-contraction rate
for one explicit canonical system) and replaces the wrong
trace-class currency by the right one; it does not remove the
positivity input.  Disclosures travel with the record:
pre-freeze float64 calibration, two smokes (six fixes, including
a normalization slip caught by the $\Delta = -\mathrm{tgt}$
pattern of the table itself) and a first-full-run abort at a
circular liveness filter (repaired and disclosed in the spec,
SPEC-hash change documented) --- no bar, grid, ladder or
verdict-bearing rule moved in any shakeout.

\begin{quote}
\textbf{Where the day's arc ends} (sandbox; no RH claim): the
wall route is closed as a theorem (the OCT of
Section~\ref{sec:kill-atlas-oct}); the real-root architecture is
adjudicated with its measured support convicted circular, and
the missing object reduced to eigenvector sign-change positions
with an exact source-only predictor
(Section~\ref{sec:realroot-signpos}); the pin route is the
sharpest reduction --- countably many safe scalars in the
absolutely convergent half-plane; and the Krein carrier is the
first host whose convergence is \emph{not} a transcription of
cached zeros --- and at the bottom of every route, machine-%
verified, sits the same single input: Weil positivity, in one
currency or another.  The program's map of why RH does not fall
to it is now complete through the object-construction and
resolvent directions, with the two open lemmata precisely
stated: Weyl-disk contraction of one explicit canonical
system (stated by round 90 with a $\sigma \downarrow 1/2$
uniformity that round 92 later showed not load-bearing ---
pointwise at the pins suffices; the adjective is retired of
record with round 109, Section~\ref{sec:frontier-audits}), and
the sign-change positions of one explicit ground eigenvector.
\end{quote}

\emph{Scope, in the same breath.}  All of this is exploration:
finite measurements on reachable windows ($x \le 13$; $x \sim
21$ continuations priced and not claimed), no all-$x$ and no
all-$a$ statement, no positivity claim, no promotion.  The SV
skeleton is conditional on the CF realness hypothesis; the
carrier's convergence is a finite measurement of a lemma, not
its proof; and the lemma's hypothesis is the very positivity the
program has not supplied.  RH is neither proven nor disproven
here.  \textbf{No statement about the Riemann Hypothesis is
made.}

\subsection{What any cohomology for
\texorpdfstring{$\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb{Z}$}{Spec Z} must
supply: a machine-grounded specification (sandbox
probes)}\label{sec:cohomspec}

Three closing discovery freeze rounds of 2026-08-15 (notes
CCCXCII, CCCXCIII and CCCXCV) then turned the campaign's machine-checked
characterization of the missing input into a literature-facing

+ 1/r$ lies in $(1,2]$ and accumulates at the \emph{interior}

every $N$ --- forward, each zero contributes symbolically

f_c \star \tilde f_c\rangle$ is gated symbolically exactly and

\emph{is} Weil positivity on exponential autocorrelations, by

edge).  (P7, citation-typed)~\textbf{The function-field
precedent, mapped to where it breaks}: in Weil's proof the
pairing is the intersection pairing on $C \times C$, the
structural positivity is the Castelnuovo--Severi/Hodge-index
inequality, and Frobenius supplies the special cycle; for
$\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb{Z}$ the sought analogues are
positivity $\leftrightarrow$ P1--P6, Frobenius $\leftrightarrow$
the arithmetic flow (Deninger's foliated dynamical system; the
Connes--Consani scaling action with periodic orbits of lengths
$\log p$), and the surface $\leftrightarrow$ the missing
absolute-geometry substrate
(``$\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb{Z} \times_{\mathbb{F}_1}
\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb{Z}$,'' the square of the scaling
site).  The break points, verified against the current
literature: Deninger's program has the shape of the cohomology
and reads the explicit formula as a dynamical Lefschetz trace
formula (Doc.\ Math.\ ICM 1998; arXiv:math/0505354), and the
conjectured trace formula is now \emph{proved} for smooth
foliated flows with the required simple structure ({\'A}lvarez
L{\'o}pez--Kordyukov, arXiv:2402.06671) --- but no arithmetic
dynamical system realizing $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb{Z}$ has
been constructed, so the trace formula has no arithmetic host
yet; Connes--Consani have Riemann--Roch on the periodic orbits
$C_p$ of the scaling site and for the ring $\mathbb{Z}$ (Selecta
Math.\ 2017 and sequels) but \emph{not} on the square of the
scaling site --- exactly the surface substitute whose
Hodge-index inequality would be the structural positivity ---
while their semilocal/prolate line supplies the
archimedean-place positivity (arXiv:2006.13771, Selecta Math.\
2021) and reduces RH to an Euler-factor property $P(n)$
(arXiv:2310.18423) --- Weil positivity in the corpus's measured
currency, with the prime places exactly where P5's control
deaths sit --- and Connes' 2026 extremal construction
(arXiv:2602.04022; zero reality by Connes--van Suijlekom
Thm~6.1) leaves open precisely the convergence the corpus
adjudicated \textsc{realroot-depth-undecided}.  The
corpus-checkable content of P7 is that the cited extremal
construction is carried and was executed here, and that the
interface such a theory must match is exactly the (AC) object of
P4; the external literature claims are citations, never gates.

\emph{Scope, in the same breath.}  The specification sheet is a
\emph{requirements document derived from machine-checked
no-gos}: it proves nothing about Deninger's program or
Connes--Consani, asserts no defect and no progress of either,
claims no progress on RH in any direction, and explicitly types
as \textbf{open} whether any cohomological theory can meet the
specification --- the standing counter-evidence
(\textsc{no-witness}: all certified reads positive to
$h = 12632$) and the finite-rung scope of the Obstruction
Completeness Theorem travel with every property.  What the sheet
adds over the published state of the art is precision, not
evidence: the missing theorem's interface is now stated sharply
enough to be tested against --- at finite $N$, by machine ---
before anyone proves anything.  \textbf{No statement about the
Riemann Hypothesis is made.}

law gates, deterministic $24.0/23.8$\,s, verdict

leaves the Verblunsky prefix bit-identical (verified spread

onset $\lfloor u_{\mathrm{miss}}/\delta\rfloor - 1$; the only
empirical content is the upper offset, measured at
\textbf{onset $+$ ${\sim}2$ lags} across all truncations on the
extended window (the round-92 re-entry demystified: P5 differs
from the full stream in exactly one coefficient, nothing is
rescued, the window just gets covered).  The completed stream's

numbers --- by causality the fixed-prefix candidate class is
\emph{empty} --- and the mass-restored control ($\{2..7\}$ plus
a density tail) dies at the \emph{identical} lag $400$ as the
truncation it imitates: \textbf{mass-without-atoms does not

\subsection{The road from here: a machine-gated path to a
complete proof (sandbox probes)}\label{sec:roadmap}

Three discovery freeze rounds of 2026-08-15 (rounds 103--105;
notes CDV--CDVI) then produced the one artifact the campaign
never had: a staged, milestone-gated research roadmap from
today's frozen state to a complete RH proof, in which every
stage is falsifiable against the corpus's own instruments.
Everything in this subsection was frozen as \emph{sandbox}:
three frozen probes in the experiments tree, no module, no
ledger row, no marker moved, no gate closed or narrowed, and no
claim about the Riemann Hypothesis in any direction; the suite
stood at 906 modules at the freeze.  \textbf{Promotion of record
(2026-08-15):} the round-103 Form-A theorem (extended by
round 106) has since been promoted as
\veri{v914\_pascal\_region\_theorem.py}, and the certified
Euler--Pick floors it consumes as Stage-0/1b acceptance values
as \veri{v915\_eulerpick\_certified\_floors.py}; the suite
stands at 952 modules (after the later Epstein detection-arc,
prime-front theorem-arc, spectral-balance/edge arc, endgame-arc,
triple-cofinal-arc, post-bughunt-arc, mechanism-arc,
Bughunt-X-arc, integrable-dictionary-arc and

Sections~\ref{sec:epstein-detection-arc},
\ref{sec:prime-theorem-arc}, \ref{sec:spectral-edge-arc},

\ref{sec:postbughunt-arc}).  The

The honesty fences travel first: \textbf{a roadmap is
not progress on RH; no stage is claimed started; the mathematics
of Stages 1--2 does not yet exist} --- the artifact's value is
that every step is now falsifiable and interface-defined, so any
candidate, from anyone, can be adjudicated against frozen gates
in minutes.

\emph{The Form-A round (round 103,
\texttt{moonshot\_sol\_probe.py}, verdict
\textsc{moonshot-partial}(Form A)).}  From cited external inputs
only --- Platt--Trudgian 2021 (all zeros to height
$T = 3{,}000{,}175{,}332{,}800$ on the line), Rosser's 1941
counting envelope, and the classical $\gamma_1$ isolation; no
zero table, no zeta evaluator --- the round proved the
\textbf{largest positivity region of the campaign}: at the safe
point $a = 256$ the full Pascal field satisfies $C_{n,k}(256) >
0$ for \emph{every} $n \ge 0$ and every $0 \le k \le 10^{19}$
(extended 530-fold to $k \le 7.4\times10^{21}$ by round 106,
Section~\ref{sec:frontier-audits}) --- an infinite half-strip in
$n$ and ten quintillion complete
$k$-columns --- with the scope stated inside the theorem: it
touches the $k \to \infty$ quantifier nowhere and proves nothing
about RH.  The theorem is now load-bearing:
\veri{v914\_pascal\_region\_theorem.py} recomputes the complete
four-region partition (all decisive ratios anchored to the
run-of-record) at every suite run, together with the round-106
extension per the disclosed pinning split.  The same round killed its three suggested proof
routes with named mechanisms: the exact prime-side transmutation
turns the positive Beta spectral window into a sign-changing
generalized-Laguerre source window (the classical Laguerre zero
theorem --- no termwise-positive prime comparison exists); the
Killip--Simon/Szeg\H{o} direction dies on pure-point entropy
(the zero comb has $w = 0$ a.e., entropy $-\infty$, floor
$e \ge 0$ only); and the asymptotic-$a$ transport is nonuniform
in $(n,k)$.

\emph{The class round (round 104, note CDV,
\texttt{levinson\_class\_probe.py}, $23/23$, verdict
\textsc{levinson-adjudicated}(\textsc{levinson-fail}; tally
$24 \to 25$, $0$ PASS)).}  The last formally unexamined
classical theorem type about zero positions --- the
positive-proportion-on-the-line class (Selberg 1942; Levinson
1974, $\kappa \ge 1/3$; Conrey 1989, $> 2/5$; the standing
record $\kappa > 0.417293$ of Pratt--Robles--Zaharescu--Zeindler
2020) --- is priced against the wall budget: the literal

(an exact finite-modification argument), and even the
granted-effective reading breaches every deployed cell by 2--3
orders of magnitude (breach ratios $382/1149/1059$ at
$h = 184/388/839$); a proportion theorem must come within

($\kappa^*_{\mathrm{ledger}} = 0.9952/0.9983/0.9988$, each a
lower bound) before it can feed the wall.  \textbf{The atlas
tally moves $24 \to 25$ candidates, $0$ PASS} --- and with it
every named unconditional classical theorem type about zero
positions is formally priced: zero-free regions, zero density,
Weyl equidistribution, pair correlation, positive proportion.

\emph{The roadmap round (round 105, note CDVI,
\texttt{roadmap\_probe.py}, $29/29$ gates, SPEC
\texttt{79092ebf}, deterministic re-run identical, verdict
\textsc{roadmap-compiled}(stages; gates $29/29$)).}  Every
machine-groundable claim of the roadmap is asserted: the
acceptance-gate values re-computed from cited constants or

E4, the three lemma forms (each RH-sufficient; only the

channels
(Euler--Pick floors $N = 1$:
$[4.5917135\times10^{-2}, 4.5917136\times10^{-2}]$ down to

certified depth 86, $5290$ cells,

\textbf{Stage 1 (open; new mathematics):} structural positivity
of Hodge-index type for $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb{Z}$ --- the

formula is \emph{proved} for smooth foliated flows
(\'Alvarez L\'opez--Kordyukov, arXiv:2402.06671) but has NO

\subsection{The Epstein detection arc: the certified
Weil-positivity violation and the certified localized rate
detection of the driver (rounds 123 and 125, notes CDXXIV and
CDXXVI, 2026-08-15; promoted 2026-08-16)}
\label{sec:epstein-detection-arc}

Thirteen further discovery freeze rounds (notes
CDXIII--CDXXVI, 2026-08-15, several run as concurrent lanes)
remain sandbox except for the two durable certified results of
the Epstein detection arc, promoted to the load-bearing suite on
2026-08-16 as \veri{v916\_epstein\_weil\_violation.py} and
\veri{v917\_driver\_rate\_certification.py} (suite
$908 \to 910$).  The honesty fences travel first: \textbf{both
results concern the Epstein zeta function of
$Q = x^2 + 5y^2$, whose off-line zeros are classical
(Potter--Titchmarsh 1935 computed the first ones;
Davenport--Heilbronn 1936) --- the promoted claims are the
certified explicit finite certificates from arithmetic source
data, never the existence; both rows are typed NOT-RH-EVIDENCE
in either direction; the min-cut is unchanged (flows $4/4$): a
detector is a falsifier, not a prover, and for zeta the same
instruments at any finite window or depth prove nothing (the
all-$m$/dense-$a$/all-$L$ omega absorbs every finite
certificate).}

\emph{The certified Weil-positivity violation (round 123,

\texttt{bb51d1a3299f4f62}, $27/30$ with exactly the three
pre-declared falsified predictions failing, $968.8$~s; re-run
green-as-typed at promotion; promoted as
\veri{v916\_epstein\_weil\_violation.py}, $20/20$).}  The
$Q$-world, built \emph{purely} from the $\Lambda_Q$ sieve
($r_Q(n)$ exact lattice counts $\to$ log-derivative recursion,
exactly warded; no Euler product exists, $\Lambda_Q$ lives on
all $n$; zero cache unused, witness constants firewalled out of
every builder), dies by in-window Szeg\H{o} collapse at
$t_{\rm death} = 2.988$ (round-120 log-law point prediction

--- the round-120 background caveat is resolved: conductor alone
does not collapse.  The promoted object is the explicit

together with the full quadratic form) with
$V = x^{\mathsf T} T x = -1.9697\times10^{-2} \pm
4.3\times10^{-68}$ and two-precision agreement

violation window, mesh-free.  The value channel is typed

(the Weil/Guinand explicit formula for $\xi_Q$, cited not
re-proven).  The three pre-declared falsified predictions are

death by only $0.018$; removing all four \emph{located} off-line

\emph{The certified localized rate detection (round 125,
\texttt{driver\_cert\_probe.py}, frozen SPEC

\veri{v917\_driver\_rate\_certification.py}, $13/13$).}  The

box, then audit-polished, typed \textsc{ward}), fires in the
rate channel at depth $m^* = 14$ with certified

mechanism is the band peel: subtracting the resonant on-line

\subsection{The bordered-dictionary arc: the bordered-RHP

adjudication set --- every wall statement remains typed
\textsc{wall-equivalent} and is consumed nowhere; the measurement
rounds 250, 254 and 255 stay experiments-side (typed

\emph{The PSD base theorem (module-own, exact rationals).}
Before any probe runs, the module gates the trivial-but-load-%
bearing structural anchor: for \emph{any} positive measure the
Gram/Hankel matrix is positive definite and the border readout
$T = t^{T} G_N t = \int (\sum_i t_i x^i)^2\,d\mu \ge 0$ for
\emph{every} real border $t$ (exact Sylvester minor chain; exact
Schur complement --- the bordered matrix $[[G_N, u], [u^{T}, B]]$
is PSD iff $B \ge u^{T} G_N^{-1} u$, precisely the wall-plus-%
budget shape of the end-object); the frozen signed witness fires
the must-fail (a $\mu - \nu$ surrogate with $m_0 > 0$ breaks the
minor chain and the border $t = (-2, -\tfrac12, 2, 0, 0)$ reads
negative, exactly).  Any bordered-positivity route that consumes
only positive-basis Gram structure proves the \emph{wrong}
statement --- the wall content is exactly the quasi-definiteness
of the signed defect measure (the \texttt{v954} trivial-route
lesson, re-anchored on the bordered object).

\emph{The bordered dictionary (round 244,
\texttt{bordered\_hankel\_probe.py}, $23/23$, SPEC
\texttt{c21e15b5852126b9}).}  The Uvarov border column
$C^{\sigma}_n(z) = \int \hat\pi_n\,d\sigma/(z - x)$ carries $F_n$
as its $z^{-1}$ coefficient \emph{without} orthogonality
cancellation ($6.7\times10^{-13}$; the $\tilde\mu$-column
coefficient is $0$ --- the contrast \emph{is} the orthogonality);
the strongest piece is the CD-kernel form of the budget,
$S_{n-1} = \iint K_n\,d\sigma\,d\sigma$ with $K_n(x,y) =
(Y_n^{-1}(y)Y_n(x))_{21}/(y - x)$: \textbf{the budget is an RHP
functional of the terminal $Y_n$ data alone}
($3.7\times10^{-15}$ on $42 + 3$ worlds) --- any later
asymptotics needs only $Y_n$; the Uvarov tau step
$\tau^{b}_{n+1}/\tau^{b}_n = h_n(1 - \rho_n/(B - S_{n-1}))$ is
rational-exact (mp $7.1\times10^{-58}$), the bordered determinant
identity is affine in $B$ (gated at two budgets, hence for all
$B$), and the bordered \textsc{lax1} flow $F_{n+1} = T_n -
\hat\alpha_n F_n - \hat\gamma_n F_{n-1}$ with source $T_n = \int
x\,\hat\pi_n\,d\sigma$ and autonomous corner $D_{n+1} = D_n -
\rho_n$ runs mp-exact through all $184$ w9 degrees
($7.0\times10^{-159}$).  Measured and typed: all three sealed
canonical corner candidates \emph{fail} the PSD census ($0/42$
each --- \textsc{corner-imported-only}: $S_{N-1}$ exceeds every
source-pure positive geometry on every window), and the budget is
\textbf{head-heavy, not edge-heavy} ($\arg\max\rho$ at degree $0$
on $42/42$, Gini $0.91$ --- \textsc{irregular-bulk}: the later
Szeg\H{o}/steepest-descent analysis must control a highly
non-uniform bulk, not a terminal boundary layer).

\emph{The rank adjudication (round 245,
\texttt{bordered\_finite\_rank\_probe.py}, $29/29$, SPEC
\texttt{886c65618145b838}).}  The last open FINITE question is
decided in the most favorable case: \textbf{the border is a
Schlesinger rank-1 insertion} --- no irreducible $3\times3$, no
growing rank.  The RHP matrix size is $3\times3$ but
unipotent/triangular (the third column is the $F$-sourced Uvarov

skew-product reading machine-verified --- the border creates no

compression} $T = \iint [K_N - K_8]\,d\sigma^{\circ}
d\sigma^{\circ}$ is exact at dps $160$ \emph{through the full

\emph{The three exact error formulas (round 251,

\subsection{The half-filling pinning theory: four theorems, four
refutations, and the north star in reinstform (rounds 279--281,
notes DCXII/DCXIV/DCXV, 2026-08-25; promoted 2026-08-25)}
\label{sec:pinning-theory-arc}

Wave 5 executes the reviewer demand to freeze the pinning rounds
\emph{as a small mathematical theory, not just as experiments}:
\veri{v962\_halffilling\_pinning\_theory.py} (rounds 279/280/281;
first-pass records $32/32 + 29/29 + 28/28$, zero fails; the three
probes embedded byte-exact in their sealed \texttt{--smoke} stage
with SPEC SHAs pinned, plus a module-own exact section in pure
Fractions that re-derives the theory from scratch), suite $954
\to 955$.  \textbf{The four theorems, as named gates.}  (T1)
\emph{The moment counting theorem} (r281, Identity): the pivot
$h_n$ consumes the moments $m_0..m_{2n}$; an $S$-atom signed
measure has exactly $S$ free moments $m_0..m_{S-1}$, every later
moment being forced by the monic node-polynomial recurrence ---
hence the free pivots are \emph{exactly} $h_0..h_{N_w-1}$ and
$h_{N_w}$ is the first forced one: \textbf{half-filling is the
end of the free moment space} (arithmetic-exact for all $S =
2..2000$; the freedom demonstration is exact in rationals: $dm =
e_{S-1}$ moves $h_{N_w-1}$ alone).  The reviewer question ``why
half-filling'' is thereby \emph{answered by counting} --- no
secret.  (T2) \emph{The crossing budget theorem} (r279,
Identity): $\#\{n < S : h_n < 0\} = S_-$ exactly (Jacobi's
minor-sign rule plus the Sylvester congruence $G_S = VWV^T \sim
W$), \emph{world-blindly}: the total Maslov crossing budget over
the full algebraic continuation is the negative-atom count (w9
$104$, w13 $98$, controls $141/94/6$, kz15 $121$, kz52 $551$).
(T3) \emph{The two-sided parity theorem} (r279, Identity):
$\mathrm{sign}\,Q_n(x_j) = e_j(-1)^{S-1-j}\mathrm{sign}(h_n)$ at
every node and degree, so the union occupancy of every open atom
gap is odd in every weight-agreement gap (never empty) and even
in every disagreement gap --- $h$-blind, at every degree; the
census bilanz $c_n + c^{\#}_{S-1-n} = (S-1) - |D| +
2\,\mathrm{scD}(n)$ holds exactly at every degree and by
exhaustion over all $87376$ sign-vector pairs $k \le 8$.  (T4)
\emph{The main window reduction}: given T1 and T2, \textbf{the
entire open statement of the wall is $\min C \ge N_w$, exactly
equivalent to $\forall n < N_w : h_n > 0$} --- no size question,
no cancellation question, no orientation question remains: one
placement question, whose reinstform is the reformulated north
star, \emph{why is the signed prime moment form quasi-definite up
to the maximally free order?}  \textbf{The four refutations, as
named negative gates} (the negative information is itself
load-bearing): \textsc{no-universal-o1-pinning} (r281, exact: the
one-negative toy has offset $N_w - 2$, unbounded in $S$ --- any
$O(1)$ upper side must consume the comb structure; the only
provable ceiling today is the T2 pigeonhole $\min C \le S - S_-$,
and $C \le 5$ is a 42-rung \emph{measurement});
\textsc{no-extremality} (r280, measured plus exact witness: three
structured mp-confirmed directions push the w9 crossing $184 \to
185$ \emph{past} half-filling, and a 4-atom one-negative measure
has $\min C = N_w + 1$ exactly --- $N_w$ was the free-window
bound, never an absolute maximum);
\textsc{no-generic-maslov-obstruction} (r279, exact: three
rational counterexamples --- the two-sided machinery is
world-blind classical structure and provably carries no
arithmetic); \textsc{no-simple-offset-law} (r281, measured: six
sealed source-pure candidates reach max $|\mathrm{sp}| = 0.273
\ll 0.75$, all world-blind).  Ledger:
\texttt{PRIME.WALL.\allowbreak HALFFILLING\_PINNING\_THEORY.01}
[E]; rounds 279--281 consumed on
\texttt{ORIENTED\_THEOREM.01} [O] (theorem share promoted, the
center precisified); the successor contracts
\texttt{PRIME.PORT.\allowbreak REPRESENTATION.\allowbreak
CONTEST.01} [O] and \texttt{PRIME.PORT.RHP.\allowbreak
FULLSOURCE.\allowbreak QUASIDEFINITENESS.01} [O] are in flight at
this cut and \emph{not} consumed (both executed and consumed in
wave 6, \vref{sec:lstar-arc}).  In Lean the hole is now
fog-free: \texttt{free\_window\_positivity}
(\texttt{rh/lean/RH/Window.lean}) is the one central
\texttt{sorry} in base coordinates (via T4 equivalent to the base
half of the master theorem), T1 and T4 are \emph{proved}, T2 is
stated, and the exact one-negative instance is a permanent
counterexample guard.  Mincut base 4 / refined 5 unchanged.
\textbf{No statement about the Riemann Hypothesis is made.}

\subsection{The L* reduction: the canonical form of the open
center, the four-language elimination, and the honest margin
decay (rounds 282--285 and the standalone problem, notes
DCXVI/DCXVII/DCXIX--DCXXI, 2026-08-25; promoted 2026-08-25)}
\label{sec:lstar-arc}

frame the full Hankel form of the signed defect measure
$\tilde\mu = \mu - \nu$ is congruent to $D_\mu - G$ with the
leading minors \emph{preserved} exactly
($\mathrm{minor}_k(D_\mu - G) = D_k(\tilde\mu)$ at every $k \le
S_+$); quasi-definiteness through the free window is exactly the
strict contraction of the $\nu$-dressed $\mu$-Christoffel-Darboux
kernel ($h_0..h_{m-1} > 0 \iff \lambda_{\max}(E_m) < 1$, both
truth values gated), and $\lambda_{\max}$ crosses $1$

\[

\qquad\text{equivalently}\qquad
\lambda_{\max}(E_{N_w}) < 1
\]
--- registered as the standalone contract

\subsection{Kernel-Loewner positivity at $L=0.3$
(rounds 494--495, promoted 2026-09-01)}\label{sec:kernel-loewner-03}

Rounds r494 $+$ r495 freeze as one module
\veri{v1017\_\allowbreak kernel\_\allowbreak loewner\_\allowbreak positivity.py}
(\texttt{PRIME.\allowbreak RDAGGER.\allowbreak KERNEL\_LOEWNER.01},
Numerical/certified float64 --- not interval arithmetic, not~\mE;
suite $1009\to1010$, ledger $1173\to1174$).  Unlike the embedding waves,
the module re-derives the bound from scratch (no probe imports).
\emph{Scope is a single finite support:} $\mathrm{supp}(h)\subset[-0.3,0.3]$,
so $2L=0.6<\log 2$ and the classical prime term is empty.  The $x$-space
Weil form
\[
  Q_W(h)=\int_0^{2L} k(x)\bigl(g(0)-g(x)\bigr)\,dx - c_L\,g(0)+\Pi(h),
\]
with $k(x)=e^{x/2}/\sinh x$ and
$\Pi(h)=2\bigl(\langle h,\cosh(x/2)\rangle^2-\langle h,\sinh(x/2)\rangle^2\bigr)$,
agrees with the defining digamma multiplier at the calibration gate
($\sigma_A(0)=-5.3721834192256654$, Dirichlet Rayleigh $1.180{\times}10^{-2}$,
odd Legendre sector $0.2226$, $c_L$ in hull).  After zero-extension to
$L^2(\mathbb R)$, $I-\mathrm{Re}\,R_x$ is PSD by the Loewner identity
$\langle h,(I-\mathrm{Re}\,R_x)h\rangle=\tfrac12\|h-\tau_x h\|_{L^2(\mathbb R)}^2$;
a quintic $C^2$ cutoff books the omitted diagonal as $\kappa_w$.  A
$401$-dimensional Legendre section of a degree-$48$ Chebyshev surrogate
is enclosed by Bernstein Hilbert--Schmidt bounds; the exact tail is charged
three times.  The enclosed floor is $2.122{\times}10^{-3}$, so
\[
  Q_W(h)\;\ge\; 2.1{\times}10^{-3}\,\|h\|_2^2.
\]
Independently (r495): the translation identity holds $6/6$ exactly over
$\mathbb Q$ on two step functions (boundary-strip mass strictly positive),
and doubling $c_L$ produces a negative certificate budget.  \emph{Honest
boundary:} r496 is a method no-go for the same compact-tail completion at
$L=0.8$ --- this row does \emph{not} claim $\lambda_*(L)\ge 0$ for general
$L$, is not cofinal, and is not evidence for or against the Riemann
Hypothesis.

% =====================================================================

asymptotic mountain that stands between all of it and any infinite
